title: Applications Development Senior Programmer Analyst – CitiKYC MIS Cognos Reporting
description: Discover your future at Citi Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. Job Overview Job Description We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced MIS Reporting Developer / Senior Programmer Analyst to join our CitiKYC Reporting Technology team. The ideal candidate will serve as a lead reporting specialist with extensive, proven expertise in developing and managing global enterprise-level reports, semantic models, and distribution frameworks using IBM Cognos Analytics as the primary business intelligence toolset, complemented by strong visualization and dashboarding capabilities. The candidate must have strong hands-on proficiency in querying, optimizing, and analyzing large datasets primarily hosted on Oracle databases, ensuring high performance, data integrity, and strict adherence to regulatory reporting reliability standards. Job Background / Context Know Your Customer (KYC) is an enterprise due diligence process executed when accepting, or periodically renewing, business relationships. This process ensures compliance with global Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulations, Customer Identification Program Procedures (CIP-P), and other regulatory mandates designed to protect Citi from financial crime risks. CitiKYC is a unified global platform across Citi's business lines. Its core objective is to reduce KYC complexity through process standardization, automated workflows, and robust regulatory MIS reporting. This team is directly responsible for delivering reporting solutions that monitor KYC record throughput, backlog, SLA management, and compliance risk indicators for senior management and regulatory bodies. Key Responsibilities Cognos Enterprise Reporting (Primary): Lead the end-to-end design, development, enhancement, and maintenance of operational, regulatory, and management reports using the full IBM Cognos Analytics suite (Report Studio, Query Studio, Dashboard, Event Studio, and Framework Manager / Data Modules). Oracle Data Layer & Query Optimization (Primary DB): Write, fine-tune, and optimize complex Oracle SQL queries, PL/SQL blocks, views, and stored procedures to extract, aggregate, and transform high-volume datasets efficiently. BI Administration & Security: Implement best practices for enterprise BI administration, metadata modeling, role-based access control, object-level security, and scheduled report distribution across Cognos environments. Requirements & Strategy: Collaborate closely with Business Analysts, KYC Operations leads, Compliance Officers, and Data Architects to translate complex business and regulatory requirements into scalable reporting solutions. Maintenance & Performance Tuning: Troubleshoot report failures, resolve data discrepancies, and optimize report execution times and database access paths for peak operational efficiency. Mentorship & Support: Provide technical guidance, code/model reviews, and mentorship to junior developers; deliver training and tier-3 support to end-users on reporting tools. Knowledge & Experience Essential 6+ years of professional experience in enterprise reporting and BI development, with IBM Cognos Analytics (including Cognos 10.x/11.x) as the primary tool. Advanced Cognos Expertise: Deep proficiency in Framework Manager metadata modeling (relational and dimensional), complex multi-page and master-detail report authoring, drill-through definitions, event-driven scheduling, and Cognos security models. Primary Database (Oracle): Strong hands-on experience with Oracle SQL / PL/SQL , query optimization, execution plans, indexing strategies, and relational database / data warehousing architectures. SDLC: Solid experience working through full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) phases under both Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall methodologies. Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to articulate technical solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Desirable / Good to Have Starburst / Presto: Experience with Starburst Presto for federated query execution, data integration, and access governance. NoSQL / Alternate Data Sources: Exposure to MongoDB or big data repositories. Domain Knowledge: Functional understanding of AML / KYC, Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), and regulatory compliance metrics. Report Migration: Prior experience converting legacy reports or migrating reports between platforms Automation & Scripting: Familiarity with workload automation and scheduling tools (Autosys, Cron), Unix/Linux shell scripting, or Cognos Java SDK. Qualifications & Certifications Essential Bachelor’s / Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related quantitative discipline. title: Application support Analyst
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice Team Overview TUCI Production Support is a 24x7 support and engineering function under TransUnion’s DevOps organization supporting business, products and customers of TransUnion Consumer Interactive (TUCI). We are focused on maintaining application reliability, stability, and performance of the mission-critical platforms across multiple geographies, ensuring business continuity through robust support practices and operational excellence. We operate under a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) framework, blending technical depth with operational rigor. Our team serves as the connective layer between development, infrastructure, and business units—delivering seamless application experiences to our customers worldwide.

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week. Role Overview And Core Responsibilities We are looking for a skilled Application Support Analyst to join our 24x7 production support team. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in supporting applications hosted on cloud platforms and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes), with deep expertise in Linux, SQL, and automation. The role involves incident management, batch job execution, shell scripting, and active participation in bridge calls. Excellent communication and collaboration skills are essential for coordinating with internal teams and external vendors to ensure timely resolution and system stability. Job Description Provide L1 and L2 support for critical business applications, ensuring high availability and rapid incident resolution. Monitor application and infrastructure health using tools like Grafana, Splunk, AppDynamics, and Spotfire. Handle bridge calls during major incidents, ensuring effective communication and coordination across teams. Troubleshoot and resolve incidents, perform root cause analysis, and collaborate with development and infrastructure teams for permanent fixes. Execute and monitor batch jobs, cron jobs, and scheduled tasks; ensure timely completion and issue resolution. Develop and maintain shell scripts and automation tools to streamline support operations. Participate in release and change management activities, including pre- and post-deployment validations. Work with DevOps tools such as Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines in cloud environments (AWS/Azure). Follow ITIL processes including Incident, Problem, and Change Management using tools like ServiceNow or BMC Remedy. Document support procedures, RCA reports, and knowledge base articles for operational efficiency. Communicate effectively with stakeholders, providing timely updates, impact assessments, and resolution plans Required Knowledge And Experiences 2-3 years of experience in Application Support, preferably in a 24x7 environment. Strong hands-on expertise in Linux/Unix systems, including shell scripting and system troubleshooting. Proficiency in SQL for data analysis and issue investigation. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and supporting distributed applications. Familiarity with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes. Prior experience in automation of support tasks using scripting languages (Shell, Python). Exposure to ITSM tools like ServiceNow or BMC Remedy. Experience in handling bridge calls and coordinating with multiple teams during high-priority incidents. Solid understanding of ITIL processes and certified in ITIL or other relevant frameworks. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration across teams and vendors. Experience with Ab Initio, cron jobs, and batch processing is a plus. Apply SRE principles to improve reliability, scalability, and performance of supported applications through proactive monitoring and automation. Focus on reducing toil by automating repetitive tasks and improving operational efficiency. Participate in blameless postmortems and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives based on incident learnings. Drive observability enhancements by integrating metrics, logs, and traces into monitoring dashboards. Collaborate with engineering teams to define and measure SLIs/SLOs, ensuring alignment with business availability goals. TransUnion Overview: At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our Workforce for Good , which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence. Be a part of our Workforce for Good – you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology. TransUnion Job Title Analyst, Applications Support

description: Program Analyst Job #: req39458 Organization: World Bank Sector: General Services Grade: GE Term Duration: Open-Ended Staff (OPEN-OP) Recruitment Type: Local Recruitment Location: Chennai,India Required Language(s): English Preferred Language(s): Closing Date: 12/3/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC Description At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. title: Data Analyst – Databricks & Power BI
description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Your Role As a Data Analyst at Kyndryl, you will unlock the power of data to drive strategic decisions and shape the future of our business. You will harness your expertise in data analysis, business fundamentals, statistics, and communication to uncover valuable insights and transform raw data into meaningful visualizations and compelling stories that influence real-world outcomes. You will have the opportunity to work with vast and complex datasets, helping customers better understand their environments through data-driven insights. By identifying trends, patterns, and opportunities within the data, you will enable smarter decision-making and support business transformation initiatives across the organization. Join Kyndryl and gain the trust, autonomy, and collaboration needed to help organizations turn data into one of their most valuable assets. Develop insightful reports, dashboards, visualizations, and data-driven recommendations for business stakeholders. Collaborate with customers and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives, project requirements, and success criteria. Translate complex business problems into analytical approaches and actionable solutions. Leverage statistical methods, business intelligence tools, and analytical techniques to generate meaningful insights. Communicate findings effectively through storytelling, presentations, and visualizations that influence business decisions. Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying data quality issues, process inefficiencies, and opportunities for optimization. Partner with technical and business teams to ensure data is properly prepared and aligned with organizational goals. Drive data-informed decision-making by delivering accurate, timely, and actionable analysis. You will work with talented professionals and collaborate on innovative projects that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data. Your Future at Kyndryl As a Data Analyst, you will work closely with business leaders, customers, data professionals, and technology teams to solve complex challenges through data. Whether you aspire to become a Data Scientist, Business Intelligence Specialist, Analytics Consultant, Data Engineer, or Data Architect, Kyndryl provides the opportunities, mentorship, and resources to help accelerate your career growth. However, equally as important, you have a growth mindset and are keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused, someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless, naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Strong experience with Databricks, including Delta Live Tables (DLT), Databricks SQL, and Python. Working knowledge of Power BI data modelling, including relationships, measures, DAX, and Power Query. Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, aggregations, data transformation, and query optimization. Experience validating and troubleshooting data feeds, identifying data quality issues, and implementing corrective actions. Knowledge of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modelling, ETL/ELT processes, and data lifecycle management. Experience handling multiple file formats, including CSV, TXT, Excel, JSON, and other structured data sources. Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. Preferred Technical and Professional Experience Experience developing and maintaining Power BI datasets, semantic models, and reporting solutions. Experience contributing to Silver and Gold layer modelling within Databricks or modern Lakehouse architectures. Knowledge of data governance, master data management, and data quality best practices. Experience using Python for data transformation, automation, and data quality validation. Working knowledge of Azure Data Platform services, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Synapse Analytics. Experience supporting financial, operational, sales, or customer analytics reporting environments. Experience creating and maintaining technical documentation, data dictionaries, business rules, and process documentation. Advanced SQL skills and a strong understanding of relational data, joins, aggregations, views, stored procedures and query performance. Experience validating data and reconciling results across source systems, data platforms and reporting outputs. Experience across the full delivery lifecycle: requirements, development, testing, deployment, monitoring and support. Ability to analyze ambiguous problems, explain technical trade-offs and work well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience with source control and delivery practices such as Git , pull requests, work tracking, peer review and release management. A strong ownership mindset, attention to detail and a commitment to accurate, reliable reporting. Good to Have Experience with Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory or similar cloud data platforms. Experience building or supporting operational reporting solutions. Familiarity with ETL/ELT workflows, dbt, PySpark, Python , data observability or automated data-quality checks. Experience supporting financial, operational, customer, product or executive reporting. Experience modernizing reporting platforms or migrating reports, datasets and data models between environments, especially SSRS to Power BI paginated reports . Experience using automation or AI-assisted workflows to improve report development, documentation, testing or support. What Success Looks Like Reporting solutions are accurate, reliable and fast, with clear ownership and documentation. Business stakeholders get clear, consistent insights and can trust the definitions and data behind their reports. Production issues and data-quality gaps are investigated thoroughly and fixed for good. The team delivers reporting enhancements predictably while improving reuse, automation, testing and maintainability. You help build a collaborative, accountable team that keeps improving. IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences. We deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products. Global Business Services: Delivering streamlined, scalable support, enhancing efficiency, compliance and service excellence across the company. The role is based in Hyderabad, India ( hybrid role ). Where You'll Make a Difference Monitor and analyze Selling, General & Administrative (SG&A) costs across corporate functions, leveraging SAP, CFIN, and related financial systems to ensure accurate and reliable financial information. Reconcile actual results against budget and forecast, investigating key cost drivers, significant variances, and financial discrepancies. Support month-end close activities by reviewing spend, validating financial data, and ensuring costs are accurately recorded and classified. Support budgeting and forecasting cycles by incorporating actual results, business assumptions, and updated financial inputs. Partner with corporate functions to provide visibility into spending, address cost-related inquiries, and ensure alignment between financial records and business activities. Translate financial data into clear and actionable insights for senior stakeholders, highlighting trends, risks, and areas requiring attention. Support compliance with financial policies, internal controls, and approval processes, ensuring consistent and disciplined cost management practices. Proactively identify, investigate, and escalate issues or discrepancies while coordinating with stakeholders to drive timely resolution. Contribute to process improvement and reporting simplification initiatives, enhancing data quality, consistency, and operational efficiency across finance processes. What Makes You the Right Fit Qualified accounting professional with a recognized certification such as CA, CMA, CPA, CIMA, or ACCA. 5-7 years of experience in finance, accounting, financial planning, or related business functions. Strong understanding of accounting concepts including accruals, prepayments, expense management, and SG&A cost structures. Proficient in financial systems and tools such as SAP, CFIN, and advanced Microsoft Excel. Skilled in performing financial reconciliations and ensuring consistency of data across multiple reports and systems. Experienced in analyzing actual results against budgets and forecasts, identifying variances, and determining underlying business drivers. Ability to translate financial findings into clear, actionable insights for senior stakeholders and business leaders. Demonstrates a proactive approach to issue identification, risk escalation, and resolution tracking to support timely decision-making. Builds effective partnerships across functions, fostering collaboration and ensuring successful delivery of financial objectives. How Would You Stand Out? Previous experience supporting SG&A or corporate functions within a multinational organization. Experience working within Global Business Services (GBS), shared services or a corporate Finance environment. Experience with Central Finance (CFIN) or similar financial reporting and consolidation environments. Why Choose Us? Gain exposure to corporate Finance and senior leadership within a global organization. Build expertise across cost management, budgeting, forecasting and financial analysis. Partner with diverse corporate functions and develop strong Finance business partnering capabilities. Contribute to projects that improve financial visibility, reporting quality and operational efficiency. Access learning and development opportunities that can support future growth into FP&A, cost management or broader Finance roles. Join a collaborative and inclusive environment where your insights and ideas can make an impact. We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, or disability. title: IT Intern
description: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description Associate Analyst – Supply Chain Data, Integration & Analytics About Thermo Fisher Scientific At Thermo Fisher Scientific, everything we do begins with our Mission — to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. As a global leader in serving science, we deliver innovative solutions that impact healthcare, life sciences, and research worldwide. Our values — Integrity, Intensity, Innovation, and Involvement — shape how we work together. Role Overview We are looking for a curious, analytical graduate who enjoys working with data and technology to join our Supply Chain IT team as an Associate Analyst for supply chain data, integration, testing, and analytics . Our supply chain runs on connected systems — ERP (SAP, Oracle JD Edwards, Oracle Cloud SCM), planning (Kinaxis), and warehouse management (Manhattan). Every forecast, order, and shipment depends on data moving accurately between these systems . When an interface fails or master data is wrong, plans break and products are delayed. In this role, you will help make sure our data is correct, connected, tested, and turned into insight . You will learn how data flows end-to-end — from item master, to plan, to shipment — and progressively take ownership of interface monitoring, data quality checks, system testing, and reporting alongside experienced data engineers and application specialists. No prior work experience is expected — we will train you. What we need from you are strong fundamentals in SQL and data, logical thinking, attention to detail, and the curiosity to understand how the business actually uses the data. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate who wants to build a career at the intersection of data engineering, integration, quality assurance, analytics, and AI in supply chain . How You Will Grow in Your First Year Months 0–3 | Learn: Structured onboarding on supply chain processes and our system landscape; SQL, data model, and integration fundamentals; shadow interface monitoring and testing cycles. Months 3–6 | Contribute: Run data quality and reconciliation checks; execute test scripts and log defects; build or enhance simple reports and dashboards. Months 6–12 | Own: Independently monitor defined interfaces and resolve routine data issues; automate at least one recurring check or report; contribute to test planning for a release or project. Key Responsibilities Monitor data interfaces and integration jobs between ERP, Kinaxis, WMS, and other applications; identify failures, analyze errors, and coordinate resolution. Write SQL queries to validate, reconcile, and troubleshoot data across source and target systems. Perform data quality checks on master data (items, bills of material, lead times, sourcing rules, locations) and transactional data; highlight gaps and help drive corrections with data owners. Help document data flows, field mappings, transformation rules, and interface specifications. Prepare and execute test cases for system integration testing (SIT), regression testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT); log, track, and retest defects. Prepare test documentation and evidence in line with computer system validation (CSV) and GxP requirements. Build and maintain reports and dashboards (e.g., Power BI) that track supply chain KPIs, data quality, and interface health. Automate repetitive checks, reconciliations, and reports using SQL, Python, or low-code tools. Assist data engineers with data preparation and pipelines on our cloud data platforms. Work with functional analysts, developers, planners, and business users to understand requirements and explain data issues in plain language. Explore how analytics, machine learning, and AI can detect data anomalies, predict failures, and improve supply chain decisions. What We Look For Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related discipline. Solid fundamentals in SQL and relational databases (joins, keys, aggregations) through coursework or projects. Basic programming ability in Python or a similar language. Strong analytical and problem-solving ability with high attention to detail. Good Excel skills for data analysis. Conceptual understanding of how data moves between systems — files, APIs, or databases. Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain a data problem to a non-technical user. Interest in learning how supply chains and enterprise business applications work. Good to have Exposure to Power BI, Tableau, or another BI/reporting tool. Academic or project exposure to cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks) or ETL/integration tools. Understanding of software testing concepts — test cases, defect lifecycle, regression testing. Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON/XML, or flat-file data formats. Coursework in supply chain, operations, or ERP concepts. Exposure to Generative AI / LLMs, or machine learning projects such as forecasting or anomaly detection. Familiarity with Agile / Scrum and tools such as Jira or Git. An internship, hackathon, or live project involving data analysis, data engineering, or testing. Why join us Competitive salary with annual performance-based bonus. Comprehensive medical insurance covering you, your spouse, children, and dependent parents. Structured onboarding, a 12-month learning plan, and a dedicated mentor for your first six months. Sponsored certifications in data, analytics, and cloud technologies relevant to your role. End-to-end exposure to a global enterprise system landscape — SAP, Oracle, Kinaxis, and Manhattan WMS. Clear career progression into Data Engineer, Integration Specialist, Analytics Engineer, BI Developer, or QA/Test Lead tracks. Access to Thermo Fisher's global learning platform. Hybrid working model with flexible hours. Employee wellness programs, on-campus recreational facilities, and mental health support. Paid time off, parental leave, and company-paid holidays. Opportunity to work with global teams across the US, Europe, and APAC.

description: About The Company We, RentoMojo, were founded by IITM alums and serial entrepreneurs who worked out of almost every major city in India in his first five years of corporate career. Frustrated with the hassles of relocating from one place to the other, and tired of finding that perfect cluster of home essentials that suited their lifestyle. "The spending youth, especially the millennials & Gen Z's prefer staying light, desire flexibility and are value conscious. Willing to experiment with new stuff across categories that make life simpler and not boring, these generations are also sensitive to our planet's sustainability. Our customers and employees identify with what we do '', is what Geetansh Bamania, our Founder and CEO has to say. RentoMojo caters to the needs of the working professionals which is unmet due to nonavailability of furnished rental flats by offering furniture and appliances on rental basis, thus, providing more flexibility than owning the expensive furniture and appliances. Currently, we have 100,000+ subscribers with a typical rental period of 12-14 months. The current market size (as per a recent report by Grant Thornton) is estimated to be US$ 4.1 Billion and expected to grow to US$ 13 Billion by 2025. With 700+ people operations, the company has a presence in 16 cities across India. Looking back, Rentomojo has not only made a new market of lease which never existed for the consumer, they have also become market leaders in the consumer rental industry. Unlike the norm, they are now seeing a reverse trend wherein a version of ours is being copied in the US and UK. We are also profitable at monthly PAT since Oct 2021. Recent Media Coverage: The Economic Times , Feb 24 Role: Industrial Trainee Location: Bangalore Job Overview The Industrial Trainee will be part of the Finance team and will gain structured exposure across Financial Planning , Treasury, Financial Modelling, and Debt.Management. The role is designed to provide practical experience aligned with ICAI training requirements. The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication skills, a strong understanding of customer needs, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment. Role Responsibilities Assist in preparation of budgets, forecasts, and financial projections Support development of financial models for business planning Perform variance analysis and track key financial metrics Assist in cash flow management and working capital monitoring Prepare financial data and reports for investors Support in preparation of management reports and presentations Key Requirements Assist in preparation of budgets, forecasts, and financial projections Support development of financial models for business planning Perform variance analysis and track key financial metrics Assist in cash flow management and working capital monitoring Prepare financial data and reports for investors Support in preparation of management reports and presentations Preferred Qualifications CA Intermediate cleared (Both Groups) Eligible for Industrial Training as per ICAI norms Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Proficiency in MS Excel (Advanced level preferred) Candidates available for immediate joining preferred Note: This is a paid internship.Skills: financial models,investors,management,capital monitoring

Synchrony International Services Pvt. Ltd. is recognized as #2 among India's Best Companies to Work. Each year, Great Place to Work® identifies India's 100 Best Companies to Work For (with employee strength more than 500) through an objective and rigorous workplace culture assessment process. https://www.greatplacetowork.in/ Organizational Overview Our Analytics team comprises of data analysts who focus on improving customer/product/digital/ journey experience etc. and growth by providing full stack descriptive to prescriptive analytics via cutting edge technologies to support business objectives. The role will include understanding the request of the business, Extract, transform, validate and visualize large data to address project delivery enabling Synchrony’s growth and profitability. The model candidate must be passionate about data & analytics , knows the story and keen on learning new technologies. This position is remote, where you have the option to work from home Key Responsibilities Leverage Data and Analytical tools to create and track metrics which reflect state of the business Triangulate and analyze data from multiple sources to draw insights and make recommendations to fulfil business/project objectives Adherence to timely delivery, accuracy and documentation in line with Audit Procedures Required Skills/Knowledge Academic knowledge of SQL/SAS/Open Source concepts, ability to write and execute queries Basic Understanding of Core Concepts/ Metrics in Retail Finance Ability to articulate analysis outcomes into findings and recommendations Desired Skills/Knowledge Working Knowledge on SQL/SAS/Python to perform data manipulation Eligibility Criteria Currently pursuing the final year of BTech/MSc/MTech/MBA/MA in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Economics, or related discipline. title: Intern – Learning & Development /Data Anaytics
description: About CAST Software Businesses move faster using CAST technology to understand, improve, and transform their software. Through semantic analysis of source code, CAST produces 3D maps and dashboards to navigate inside individual applications and across entire portfolios. This intelligence empowers executives and technology leaders to steer, speed, and report on initiatives such as technical debt, GenAI, modernization, and cloud. As the pioneer of the software intelligence field, CAST is trusted by the world’s leading companies and governments, their consultancies and cloud providers. See it all at castsoftware.com. Role Overview We are looking for a motivated and analytical engineering graduate to support Learning & Development (L&D) operations, Learning Management System (LMS) administration and training initiatives within CAST. The ideal candidate should have a strong interest in Data Analytics, reporting, process automation and learning technologies. In addition to managing day-to-day LMS operations, the candidate will contribute to developing L&D metrics, monitoring training progress, identifying improvement opportunities and providing actionable insights to management. This role offers an opportunity to work with global teams and stakeholders while gaining exposure to enterprise learning platforms, data analytics and business operations. Key Responsibilities Manage and administer the eLearning platform (360Learning), including user access, course assignments, learning plans and content management. Support employees with CAST University login, navigation and course access. Manage LMS requests received from internal teams and global customers, coordinating with relevant stakeholders. Provide basic JIRA training and guidance workflow for CAST University project to employees when required. Monitor LMS usage, course completion and employee learning progress. Support the rollout of learning initiatives and internal training programs. Collect, consolidate and analyze learning data from different tools and platforms. Develop regular L&D dashboards and reports covering enrollment, course completion, learning hours, progress and training effectiveness. Contribute to the development of meaningful L&D KPIs and performance metrics. Identify learning gaps, trends and opportunities for improvement through data analysis. Present actionable insights and recommendations to management and senior stakeholders. Explore opportunities to automate recurring reports and reduce manual effort. Coordinate with internal teams, sales representatives and global stakeholders for LMS and training-related requests. Provide timely support and resolution for learning platform queries. Candidate Prerequisites & Skills Educational Background Bachelor's degree in Engineering (BE/B.Tech). Candidates from reputed engineering institutions with a background or exposure to Data Analytics will be preferred. Consistent academic performance with a minimum of 70% in 10th, 12th and graduation. Technical Skills Strong proficiency in MS Office, particularly: MS Excel – Advanced Excel, Pivot Tables, Lookups, Macros and data analysis. MS PowerPoint – Management presentations and dashboards. MS Word – Documentation and reporting. Basic understanding of Data Analytics and visualization tools. Basic knowledge of automation and reporting tools will be an added advantage. Soft Skills : Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Ability to communicate effectively with senior management and global stakeholders. Proactive attitude with a willingness to learn and take ownership. Ability to multitask and work independently. Preferred Candidate Profile A bright, self-driven engineering graduate with an analytical mindset, good communication skills and an interest in learning technologies and business operations. The candidate should be comfortable working with data, generating meaningful insights, managing multiple responsibilities and interacting with stakeholders across different geographies. The expectation is to develop this role beyond routine LMS administration, making it a combination of L&D Operations, Data Analytics, Reporting and Process Improvement.

Beige Bananas maintains an outcome-driven mindset, helping organizations accelerate value realization from their analytics and AI investments. The firm serves Fortune 500 companies across Retail, CPG, and Media sectors, building long-term partnerships based on trust and measurable results. On a day-to-day basis, you will clean and prepare datasets, conduct exploratory data analysis, build and evaluate statistical and machine learning models, and create clear visualizations and reports to communicate findings. You will contribute to proof-of-concept AI products, document methodologies, and support the translation of business questions into analytical approaches. This is a remote internship role, requiring proactive communication, reliable time management, and the ability to work effectively within distributed teams. Proficiency in Data Analytics and Data Analysis, including cleaning, transforming, and interpreting complex datasets. Experience with Data Visualization, using tools or libraries (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Matplotlib, Seaborn) to present insights clearly. Hands-on skills in programming languages commonly used in data science (such as Python or R) and familiarity with SQL. Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related discipline. Ability to communicate complex analytical findings in a clear, structured, and concise manner to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Comfort working in a remote environment, with strong organizational skills and a collaborative, outcome-focused mindset.

title: Intern
description: About REVERSE REVERSE is a Bengaluru-based cleantech startup building India’s packaging reuse infrastructure. Most packaging in India is used once and discarded, even when it can be reused multiple times. We work with brands to enable circularity for their packaging by building the systems, technology and supply chain required to collect, sort, sanitise and return packaging back into use. Our network currently includes housing societies, restaurants, hotels, cafés, collection partners and brands across Bengaluru. Today, REVERSE has: Enabled the reuse of 4.7M+ packaging units Worked with 15+ brands Built 355+ return points across Bengaluru and Goa Been supported by leading startup and innovation ecosystems, including IIM Bangalore and IIM Ahmedabad. We are now hiring interns across multiple functions to work closely with our team and help us scale packaging reuse. Open Internship Role: 1. Brand Strategy & GTM Intern (You will work on how REVERSE is positioned, communicated, and taken to market.) Key responsibilities include: Support brand strategy, positioning and communication Plan and execute growth and behaviour-change campaigns Conduct customer and market research Interact with residents, businesses, brands and channel partners Support go-to-market plans for housing societies, cafés, restaurants and other channels Experiment with messaging, acquisition channels and engagement strategies Track campaign and customer conversion data Support partnerships and new market initiatives This role is ideal for someone interested in branding, marketing, consumer behaviour, strategy, growth and entrepreneurship. 2. Supply Chain Intern (You will work closely with our operations team to understand and improve the end-to-end supply chain behind packaging reuse.) title: Lead Data Business Analyst – Wealth Data Strategy
description: Discover your future at Citi Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. Job Overview About Us With Citi’s Analytics & Information Management (AIM) group, you will do meaningful work from Day 1. Our collaborative and respectful culture lets people grow and make a difference in one of the world’s leading Financial Services Organizations. The purpose of the group is to enable building Citi’s data assets, analyze information, and create actionable intelligence for our business leaders. The Wealth Data Strategy team partners across Business, Technology, Data, Governance, and Analytics to create scalable data solutions. We work on large-scale data transformation initiatives that bring together fragmented data across regions, businesses, and source systems into trusted, consumption-ready data foundations for the Wealth organization. Position We are hiring an Assistant Vice President (C12) – Data Management/Information Sr Analyst to join the Wealth Data Strategy team. This is an exciting opportunity to play a dual Product Owner / Business Analyst role in One Wealth, Citi Wealth’s premier strategic data transformation program. You will help shape how Wealth data is sourced, modeled, governed, validated, and consumed across the global organization. The role requires a strong mix of business acumen, data knowledge, stakeholder management, and Agile execution. You will work closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, data modelers, governance partners, and downstream consumers to translate business needs into high-quality, governed data products. Key Responsibilities Product Ownership & Data Product Delivery: Own and drive data product requirements from discovery to delivery. Define scope, prioritize requirements, manage backlog, track delivery and ensure the final output meets business and consumption needs. Business Analysis & Requirement Management: Partner with business stakeholders to understand objectives, reporting needs, metrics, operational processes and pain points. Translate business requirements into clear functional, data and technical requirements. Hands-on Data Analysis: Use SQL, Python or similar tools to analyze datasets, validate source data, perform data profiling, investigate issues, create metrics and support business/data analysis. Source Data Discovery & Mapping: Work with source-system owners, technology teams and domain teams to identify required datasets, attributes, business definitions, lineage, refresh frequency, source availability and data gaps. Source-to-Target Mapping: Support detailed mapping of source attributes to target data models. Work with Tech BAs, data modellers and engineering teams to clarify mapping logic, transformation rules, derivations and dependencies. Data Model & Data Dictionary Review: Review logical models, physical models, data dictionaries and DDLs. Ensure the model supports agreed business metrics, reporting needs, analytics use cases and cross-domain consumption. Metrics & Reporting Enablement: Define and validate business metrics, KPIs and data requirements for dashboards, reports and analytics use cases. Partner with BI/reporting teams to ensure data is fit for consumption. Data Quality & Production Validation: Define validation approach, data reconciliation checks, completeness checks, DQ rules, test scenarios, PAT/UAT support and production validation. Investigate data quality issues and drive closure with technology/domain teams. Data Governance & Controls: Support data classification, sensitivity review, cross-border considerations, access controls, governance approvals and data ownership processes for data movement and consumption. AI & Automation Enablemen t: Identify opportunities to use AI and automation for data discovery, mapping, data quality rule creation, SQL generation, production monitoring, documentation and knowledge management. Stakeholder Management: Act as a trusted bridge between Business, Technology, Data Modelling, Governance, source-system teams and downstream consumers. Drive meetings, follow-ups, issue resolution and clear communication across global teams. Documentation & Executive Communication: Create and maintain clear documentation including requirements, user stories, data mappings, business definitions, data gaps, status updates, issue logs, executive summaries and presentation materials. Mentorship & Collaboration: Support junior team members by sharing domain, data and delivery knowledge. Promote ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement and strong delivery discipline within the team. Key Qualifications Education : Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Engineering, Finance or a related field. Experience: Minimum 7-8+ years of experience in Data Management, Business Analysis, Product Ownership, Data Strategy, Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Governance or related roles. Prior experience in Banking, Wealth Management or Financial Services is preferred. Product Owner / Business Analyst Experience: Strong experience working as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, Data Analyst or Data Product Lead, including requirement gathering, backlog management, stakeholder engagement, delivery tracking and business sign-off. Strong SQL Skills: Hands-on experience writing SQL queries for data analysis, profiling, reconciliation, metric creation, validation and issue investigation. Python / Analytical Programming: Working knowledge of Python or similar programming/scripting tools for data analysis, automation, validation or reporting support. Data Platform Knowledge: Good understanding of data warehouses, data lakes, ETL/ELT pipelines, metadata, lineage, source-to-target mapping, data models and data quality concepts. Experience with platforms such as Snowflake, Hadoop/Hive, Teradata or similar technologies is preferred. BI & Reporting Knowledge: Hands-on experience or strong working knowledge of BI/reporting tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Qlik, Dataiku or similar platforms. Ability to understand dashboard requirements, metrics and reporting consumption needs. Data Governance & Quality Awareness: Understanding of data classification, sensitive data handling, access controls, regulatory considerations, data quality controls, reconciliations and production validation processes. AI / Automation Awareness: Knowledge of AI use cases in data management, analytics, automation, data quality, reporting or knowledge management. Practical exposure to AI-assisted SQL generation, documentation, rule creation or automation is an advantage. Communication & Stakeholder Management: Strong communication skills with the ability to explain business, data and technology concepts clearly. Ability to work with senior stakeholders across business, technology and governance teams. Problem Solving: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to work through ambiguity, investigate data issues, connect dots across teams and drive closure. Leadership & Collaboration: Ability to work independently, influence without direct authority, mentor junior team members and collaborate effectively across global teams. Preferred Skills Domain knowledge in Wealth Management (Client/Account data, Investments, Deposits, Lending, or Financial Products). Experience working on enterprise data lakes, data warehouses, or Unified Data Models (UDMs). Familiarity with data cataloging, data quality tools, and metadata management workflows. Exposure to AI-assisted data management, automated rule generation, or knowledge management solutions. Additional Information This role provides an opportunity to work on a strategic Wealth data transformation initiative, partnering with global business and technology teams to build trusted, governed and reusable data products. The successful candidate will play a key role in shaping how Wealth data is sourced, modelled, validated and consumed across Citi, while building deep expertise across business, data, technology and governance. This is a strong opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex data problems, working with senior stakeholders and contributing to high-impact data transformation work. - Job Family Group: Decision Management - Job Family: Data/Information Management - Time Type: Full time - Most Relevant Skills Please see the requirements listed above. - Other Relevant Skills For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter. - Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.

description: Ref#: W184757 Department: Finance City: Bangalore State/Province: Karnataka Location: India Company Description Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. Monitor the P&L of a corporate function, analyzing operating expenses, headcount, and ad hoc needs and compare budget and forecast projections. In addition, analyze and interpret variances, prepare reports, and provide recommendations to management where required. Support decision-making and helping the business leaders to deliver against targets and provide financial visibility & predictability for the business. Identify financial risks and opportunities and provide recommendations to mitigate to support achievement of annual financial targets. Headcount management and reporting. Co ordinating with different vertical leads and managing expectations proactively will be a primary task. Sending out monthly reports and scheduling calls as required to remain aligned. Complete ownership of the activities with minimal supervision, while ensuring timeliness and accuracy Experience, Skills, and Knowledge Professional Skills: CA/MBA, CIMA, CMA(US) or any other master’s degree with a focus in Finance and Accounting. 2-3 years of combined Accounting, Controlling, Reporting or Financial Planning & Analysis experience. title: Global Service Desk Lead
description: About Machinify Machinify builds the AI operating system for healthcare payment intelligence, combining the minds of industry experts with the power of technology. US healthcare wastes billions of dollars a year inside the claims payment workflow, and Machinify has built a platform to fix that, backed by more than 40 years of payment integrity expertise and a product suite spanning the full claims lifecycle from pre-pay through post-pay. Today, 85+ customers rely on us, including 18 of the top 20 US health plans, covering more than 270 million member lives across commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid. We process over 3 petabytes of claims data and return more than $6 billion in savings and recoveries to our customers every year, with 99% customer retention. We're now opening a new hub in Bengaluru that isn't a satellite office or a support function: it's a genuine extension of one global Machinify, where local leaders run real teams and own real product and outcomes. The problems our teams solve are hard by design, which is exactly why they haven't been solved before, and why the work is worth doing. Joining now means building Machinify's India presence- its people, culture, and way of working- from the ground up, with real influence over what gets built and how. About the Role The Global Service Desk Lead is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of Machinify's Global Service Desk in Bengaluru. This role serves as the technical and operational leader onsite for Service Desk Analysts, ensuring exceptional support delivery, operational excellence, and adherence to service management standards. The Global Service Desk Lead acts as the primary escalation point for complex incidents, coaches and mentors analysts, drives continuous improvement initiatives, and partners closely with global IT teams to deliver a world-class support experience. This role combines leadership, technical expertise, process ownership, and service management responsibilities within a fast-paced, AI-enabled support environment. Machinify's Bengaluru Service Desk is a strategic extension of the Global IT organization, providing follow-the-sun support for employees across North America and India. The Service Desk Lead is responsible for ensuring operational consistency across shifts, driving service performance, and fostering collaboration between the Service Desk, Infrastructure, Security, Identity & Access Management, Endpoint Engineering, Enterprise Applications, and ITSM teams. The Service Desk Lead is expected to champion automation, knowledge management, AI adoption, and ITIL best practices while creating a culture focused on ownership, accountability, and customer satisfaction. What You Will Own TEAM LEADERSHIP & OPERATIONS Provide day-to-day leadership and guidance to Global Service Desk Analysts. Manage ticket queues and workload distribution to ensure SLA achievement. Monitor team performance and service quality metrics. Conduct shift handovers and operational reviews to ensure continuity of support. Act as the primary escalation point for high-priority incidents and service requests. Support onboarding, training, mentoring, and development of Service Desk team members. Foster a culture of accountability, customer service excellence, and continuous improvement. SERVICE DELIVERY Ensure incidents and requests are managed according to ITIL best practices. Monitor service levels and proactively address performance gaps. Drive timely communication and resolution of employee issues. Facilitate major incident coordination and stakeholder communications. Review ticket quality, documentation standards, and escalation practices. Ensure positive employee experiences through effective support delivery. TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP Assist with escalations involving Microsoft 365, Slack, Google Workspace, endpoint management, identity services, and enterprise applications. Partner with engineering teams to identify root causes and long-term solutions. Lead resolution efforts during critical outages and priority incidents. Support VIP and executive-level technology issues when required. PROCESS IMPROVEMENT & ITSM Drive continual service improvement initiatives. Partner with the ServiceNow and ITSM teams to improve workflows, automation, and reporting. Identify opportunities to reduce ticket volumes through self-service, automation, and knowledge management. Ensure compliance with incident, request, problem, and knowledge management processes. Review service metrics and develop action plans for improvement. KNOWLEDGE MANAGEMENT Ensure knowledge articles remain accurate, current, and effective. Lead knowledge-sharing initiatives across support teams. Promote first-contact resolution through effective documentation and analyst enablement. Establish best practices for troubleshooting and support processes. Technical Skills REQUIRED Advanced Windows and macOS troubleshooting Microsoft 365 administration and support Entra ID (Azure AD) and identity management concepts MFA, SSO, and account lifecycle management ServiceNow or similar ITSM platform Incident, Request, Change, Problem, and Knowledge Management processes Slack, Teams, Zoom, and collaboration technologies Mobile device support (iOS and Android) Networking fundamentals including DNS, DHCP, VPN, and Wi-Fi troubleshooting Reporting, metrics analysis, and service performance management PREFERRED Microsoft Intune Jamf Pro Okta Google Workspace Administration ServiceNow administration and reporting PowerShell scripting AI tools such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, and other productivity platforms Workflow automation and process optimization Qualifications REQUIRED 5-8 years of experience in Service Desk, Desktop Support, End User Computing, or Technical Support roles. 2+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or supervising support teams. Experience managing escalations and critical incidents. Strong understanding of ITIL service management practices. Experience supporting global organizations and distributed workforces. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Excellent verbal and written English communication skills. Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. PREFERRED Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. ITIL Foundation certification or higher. ServiceNow certification or advanced ServiceNow experience. Experience supporting healthcare, SaaS, or high-growth technology organizations. Experience implementing automation or AI-driven support capabilities. Shift Coverage & Support Expectations Support a global workforce across North America and India. Participate in rotational leadership coverage, including evenings, weekends, and holiday support when business needs require. Provide incident leadership during major incidents and service disruptions. Monitor operational health and ensure effective shift transitions. Maintain visibility into team performance, SLA compliance, backlog management, and customer satisfaction. Act as the operational point of contact between Bengaluru and U.S.-based IT leadership. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) SLA Compliance Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) First Contact Resolution (FCR) Ticket Backlog Reduction Escalation Management Effectiveness Knowledge Base Contribution and Utilization Service Desk Productivity and Quality Scores Major Incident Response Performance Employee and Stakeholder Satisfaction Automation and Continuous Improvement Contributions What Success Looks Like Lead a high-performing Service Desk team that consistently meets service objectives. Improve customer satisfaction and service quality metrics. Reduce escalation rates through coaching and knowledge sharing. Drive automation and self-service adoption. Maintain operational excellence across all support channels. Build strong partnerships with global IT teams and business stakeholders. Foster a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and innovation. title: Analyst, Audit AI OPS
description: About Coupang At Coupang, pricing decisions directly shape customer trust, category growth, market competitiveness, and long-term business trajectory. As pricing systems scale with sophisticated automation and data-driven models, identifying where customer outcomes, commercial performance, and market realities diverge requires forward-looking discovery beyond traditional reporting. The Audit Intelligence organization operates as an independent discovery engine across the pricing ecosystem. By leveraging AI technologies, advanced analytics, and rigorous audit methodologies, the team surfaces high-impact signals and empowers executive leadership to act on critical opportunities before they materialize into broader issues. Role Overview As an Audit Intelligence Analyst, you will build and run continuous intelligence systems that uncover customer trust opportunities, commercial growth vectors, competitive risks, and operational blind spots. Combining analytical rigor, business intuition, and AI-enabled workflows, you will convert large-scale operational and market data into high-value insights. Your work will directly guide pricing strategy, audit focus, and cross-functional execution. Collaborating with data engineers, AI agents, operations teams, and key stakeholders, you will detect weak signals in complex datasets before they impact customers or commercial performance. Why This Role Matters While traditional reporting explains past outcomes, this role anticipates future risks and opportunities. Operating guided by the Audit 2.0 core motto—"Find fast. Prove objectively. Escalate relentlessly. Drive fix that's permanent"—you will serve as a frontline catalyst for customer trust and price sharpness. Through synthesized customer, commercial, and market intelligence, you will safeguard customer trust and drive category competitiveness across Coupang's e-commerce landscape. What You Will Do Generate Customer Intelligence You will develop analytical frameworks that evaluate how pricing decisions influence customer trust, customer competitiveness, and long-term customer experience. Examples include, but are not limited to, identifying Blue Badge Trust risks where products may no longer meet customer trust expectations, surfacing pricing competitiveness gaps that impact customer conversion, detecting emerging price sharpness opportunities on highly trafficked pages, and identifying customer-facing pricing issues before they generate substantial dissatisfaction. Generate Commercial Intelligence You will identify commercial opportunities that improve growth, assortment quality, category performance, and customer adoption. Examples include, but are not limited to, identifying key products suffering from pricing-related performance challenges, surfacing underserved items experiencing abnormal demand declines on a MoM or YoY basis, identifying cold-start products requiring intervention, detecting seasonal recovery opportunities, and discovering long-tail or tail-of-tail products with unrealised commercial potential. Generate Market Intelligence You will continuously evaluate external competitive conditions and identify where Coupang is gaining or losing market competitiveness. Examples include, but are not limited to, competitiveness monitoring, comparative rank deterioration analysis, competitor promotion detection, external pricing movement analysis, category-level competitiveness shifts, and emerging market-share risk signals. Leverage AI Agents and Automation You will deploy modern LLMs and agentic workflows (GPT, Gemini, Kiro, Devin) to accelerate anomaly detection, automate repetitive investigations, and expand audit coverage. Examples include creating AI-assisted workflows that automatically investigate competitiveness losses, automate opportunity identification, generate summaries for leadership reviews, or support daily prioritization activities. Build Repeatable Intelligence Mechanisms You will help transform one-time analyses into scalable mechanisms that can continuously operate with minimal manual intervention. Examples include automated signal detection workflows, opportunity scoring systems, categorization frameworks, prioritization models, and intelligence dashboards used across Audit and Pricing organizations. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 3+ years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence, Operations Excellence, Audit, Marketplace Operations, Pricing, Strategy, or related disciplines. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience working with large datasets. Proficiency in SQL. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with AI-enabled analytical tools. Experience using Python or automation frameworks. Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms. E-commerce, marketplace, retail, or pricing experience. Experience working with Machine Learning or Applied Science teams. Type of work model Hybrid Our Hybrid work model: Coupang hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration that acts a catalyst to enrich the experience of employees. Employees are required to work at least 3 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 2 days a week, depending on the role requirement. Some businesses may require more time in office due to nature of work. Details to consider Those eligible for employment protection (recipients of veteran's benefits, the disabled, etc.) may receive preferential treatment for employment in accordance with applicable laws. title: Sr Analyst Product Support
description: Overview: POSITION SUMMARY STATEMENT: The Senior Product Support Analyst provides advanced technical and functional support for Herbalife digital applications to ensure reliable, high-quality, and customer-focused experiences for users across markets. This role is responsible for investigating, diagnosing, troubleshooting, and coordinating resolution for complex application issues affecting web, mobile, consumer-facing, backend, and integrated applications. The role owns escalated issues through investigation, communication, resolution, and closure; performs root-cause analysis; identifies recurring issues; and recommends product, process, automation, and operational improvements. The Senior Product Support Analyst partners closely with Product, Development, QA, Associate Services, Operations, and other stakeholders to ensure issues are accurately documented, effectively escalated, and resolved in a timely manner. This position requires hands-on technical troubleshooting skills across web and mobile applications, backend services, databases, APIs, integrations, application logs, and monitoring tools. The individual must be able to use browser developer tools, console logs, SQL, MongoDB, JavaScript, Postman, session-replay tools such as Quantum Metric, and logging/observability tools such as Splunk to investigate application behavior and customer-reported issues. The Senior Product Support Analyst may also support software projects and releases from requirements clarification through implementation, UAT, Hypercare, production validation, and ongoing maintenance. This role contributes to support documentation, reporting, and enhancement recommendations that improve application usability, reliability, and customer experience. DETAILED RESPONSIBILITIES/DUTIES: Serve as a subject-matter expert for assigned digital applications and provide Level 2 technical and functional support for web, mobile, consumer-facing, backend, and integrated applications. Own customer-reported issues from initial investigation through resolution and closure, ensuring timely communication, clear expectations, and a strong customer experience. Diagnose and troubleshoot complex application incidents, defects, service requests, and escalations using browser developer tools, console logs, network traces, application logs, dashboards, and monitoring tools. Investigate application behavior across frontend components, backend services, APIs, databases, integrations, authentication flows, and third-party dependencies. Use SQL, MongoDB, JavaScript, Postman, and similar technical tools to validate data, troubleshoot APIs, analyze application behavior, reproduce issues, and support root-cause analysis. Use session-replay and digital-experience tools, such as Quantum Metric (QM), and logging/observability tools, such as Splunk, to analyze customer journeys, identify technical errors, validate reported issues, and detect recurring trends. Provide Product, and Development teams with complete and actionable issue details, including business impact, reproducible steps, expected versus actual behavior, screenshots, logs, timestamps, API responses, and relevant data findings. Identify recurring defects, known errors, customer pain points, and support trends; recommend permanent corrective actions, product enhancements, process improvements, automation opportunities, and preventive measures. Participate in incident reviews and root-cause analysis; document and track corrective and preventive actions through completion. Support release-readiness activities, including requirements clarification, UAT, production validation, Hypercare, post-release monitoring, and stabilization support. Partner closely with Product Managers, Developers, Operations, Associate Services, and business stakeholders to investigate issues, clarify business rules, coordinate resolution, and improve product usability and reliability. Create and maintain knowledge-base articles, troubleshooting guides, FAQs, runbooks, known-error records, support procedures, reports, dashboards, and self-help materials. Contribute to support and product documentation, including user stories, use cases, process maps, requirements, acceptance criteria, application gap analysis, and enhancement requests. Identify and support automation initiatives that reduce manual effort, improve support efficiency, strengthen monitoring, and accelerate issue detection and resolution. Qualifications: REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS: Skills (Required): Strong functional and technical understanding of digital applications, system-support processes, and application-maintenance practices. Strong hands-on experience troubleshooting web-based and mobile applications. Strong understanding of digital application architecture, including frontend applications, backend services, APIs, databases, integrations, authentication, and third-party dependencies. Experience using browser developer tools, application consoles, console logs, network traces, and error diagnostics. Strong SQL skills for data investigation, validation, troubleshooting, reporting, and root-cause analysis. Working experience with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases. Working knowledge of JavaScript for browser-console troubleshooting, scripting, automation, or diagnostic activities. Hands-on experience using Postman or similar API tools for testing, validation, and troubleshooting of REST APIs and integrations. Experience using session-replay or digital-experience analytics tools, such as Quantum Metric (QM), FullStory, Dynatrace Session Replay, or similar tools. Experience using logging, monitoring, and observability tools, such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Kibana/Elastic, or similar platforms. Ability to analyze and correlate session-replay data, application logs, browser-console output, network traces, APIs, backend services, and database data to diagnose complex issues. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving skills. Ability to identify recurring issues and recommend process, product, monitoring, automation, or operational improvements. Demonstrated ability to achieve results with limited supervision. Ability to effectively manage multiple, competing, high-priority issues and projects with varying deadlines. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization and simplify technical concepts for non-technical audiences. Ability to interact effectively with individuals from different countries and cultures, with sensitivity to cultural diversity. Strong interpersonal, stakeholder-management, and conflict-resolution skills. Strong work ethic with emphasis on customer service, quality, ownership, and timely resolution. Ability to function effectively as a collaborative team member. Motivated self-starter with initiative, curiosity, and the ability to learn new technologies, applications, and business processes quickly. Thorough knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle methodologies, Agile delivery practices, and information-systems concepts and terminology. Experience: 8+ years of experience in application support, technical support, product support, software engineering support, systems analysis, or a related technology role. 5+ years supporting enterprise, e-commerce, consumer-facing, web, mobile, SaaS, or integrated digital applications. Experience investigating production issues involving APIs, databases, integrations, application logs, and backend services. Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, and business teams to resolve complex technical issues. Experience in incident management, root-cause analysis, and problem management. Experience in creating support documentation, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, or operational runbooks. Experience supporting software releases, UAT, Hypercare, and post-production stabilization. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant work experience may be considered. ITIL Foundation certification or practical experience with Incident, Problem, Change, and Knowledge Management processes. Experience supporting global, multi-market, e-commerce, or consumer digital platforms

description: About Ethos Ethos (Nasdaq: $LIFE) is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. About The Role This is a high-impact role for an analyst who wants to own the data behind a core part of our Consumer business and use it to change what gets built. You'll partner directly with product, design, and engineering to drive how we grow the direct-to-consumer funnel — from the moment someone lands on the site, through quote and approval, to activating their policy. It starts with a real understanding of our customers, our funnel, and the levers that move conversion and retention. That understanding is what makes your analysis worth acting on. You use it to find the highest-leverage questions, spot opportunities the team hasn't seen yet, and bring recommendations that change roadmap decisions rather than just describe what happened. The AI infrastructure we've built changes what this role looks like day to day. Mechanical analysis is faster than it has ever been, which frees you to spend your time on the parts that need judgment: framing the right question, validating what the tools produce, and drawing the conclusion the business should act on. We're further along on this than most companies, and we're still writing the playbook — you'll help shape it. You go deep in analytics and experimentation on your product area, and AI gives you the reach to cover more ground than a traditional analyst. Duties And Responsibilities Own the analytics for your product area. You partner with PMs across the Consumer funnel — landing page, quote flow, onboarding, approval, and activation — to define success metrics, find where users drop off, and make sure decisions are grounded in data. PMs make different calls because you're in the room. Be accountable for outcomes, not output. You're measured on the business impact of the decisions your analysis influences — conversion, approval rate, activation, retention — not the number of analyses you produce. You connect findings across experiments and cohorts to surface patterns a single analysis would miss. Own experimentation for your area. Design, instrument, and interpret A/B and multivariate tests — from CTA and quote-flow changes to eligibility and onboarding — with the statistical rigor to separate real lift from noise, and help raise the quality and speed of how the team runs experiments. Build deep customer and funnel understanding. Develop a rich picture of how different segments behave — return visitors, demographic cohorts, traffic sources — and turn it into product recommendations that improve conversion for each group. Own the quality of AI-assisted analysis. Our tools pull data, read configs, and draft analysis. You use them to move faster, and you own validating and sharpening what they produce. Human judgment over AI output, always. Make insights self-serve. Expert SQL, and fluency with a modern analytics stack — Snowflake and a product analytics tool like Amplitude. Python (or R) and dbt are a plus. Deep experience designing and interpreting experiments and applying statistical rigor — regression, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing. Daily use of AI tools in your analytics workflow, with a clear-eyed sense of where they accelerate the work, where they get it wrong, and where your own judgment is non-negotiable. Strong communication and storytelling — able to turn complex analysis into clear, strategic narratives for PMs, engineers, and executives. Don’t meet every single requirement?
