Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes. As a Staff AI Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Services, you will be tasked with taking ownership of our AI Gateway infrastructure (built on Kong AI Gateway), the system that authenticates, routes, rate-limits, and monitors AI coding assistant traffic org-wide, while also being fluent enough across our broader platform stack to design solutions that span the two. This is a high-autonomy, high-scope role: you will set technical direction for AI infrastructure, drive incident response and reliability work, and partner closely with the engineers who own our CI/CD, GitOps, and artifact systems rather than working in isolation from them. What Will You Do? Primary responsibilities include: Work on the AI Gateway platform: architect, harden, and scale our Kong AI Gateway deployment (Konnect Hybrid on KCP/EKS), including auth (Okta/OIDC), consumer tiers and budgets, rate limiting, semantic caching, and observability. Lead reliability and incident response: drive root-cause analysis and remediation for gateway issues (timeouts, latency, capacity, failover) and build the monitoring and alerting needed to catch them before users do. Design across the platform, not just the gateway: work fluently with our CI/CD (Jenkins, JPAAS), GitOps and Kubernetes deployment tooling (ArgoCD across dev, gov, and prod), artifact management (Artifactory/Xray), GitHub Enterprise administration, and GitHub Actions runner fleet, so that AI infrastructure decisions account for how the rest of the platform actually works. Evaluate and roll out AI developer tooling: run structured pilots and adoption efforts for tools like AI-assisted PR review (Qodo) and engineering metrics platforms (LinearB), and make clear build-versus-buy recommendations. Set technical direction and mentor: define architecture and standards for AI infrastructure, review designs across the team, and raise the bar for other engineers working in this space. Partner cross-functionally: work directly with security, DevEx, and product engineering teams consuming the gateway to translate their needs into platform capabilities. Host and serve local models: stand up and operate self-hosted and open-weight model serving infrastructure (for example vLLM, NVIDIA Triton/NIM, TGI, and Ollama) for workloads where routing to an external provider is not the right fit, including GPU capacity planning, autoscaling, and cost and performance tuning. Support the broader model lifecycle: help build LLMOps practices such as model versioning, evaluation, and safe rollout, plus supporting infrastructure for retrieval-augmented generation (vector stores and embedding pipelines) as use cases mature. Track usage and cost: build observability into token usage, latency, and spend across both API-based and self-hosted models so the business can see what AI infrastructure actually costs. What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring? Ideal candidates will have: 10- 12 years of experience in platform, infrastructure, or DevOps engineering, with a track record of owning systems end to end in production. Hands-on experience with API gateway technologies (Kong, Envoy, Apigee, or similar); direct experience with AI and LLM gateway patterns (rate limiting, semantic caching, prompt and response observability) is a strong plus. Strong Kubernetes and GitOps experience (ArgoCD or comparable), and comfort operating across multiple environments (dev, gov, and prod). Solid CI/CD background: Jenkins pipeline design and administration, build infrastructure, and runner and agent fleet management (GitHub Actions runners or equivalent). Experience with artifact and package management systems (Artifactory, Xray, or similar) and source control platform administration (GitHub Enterprise). Working knowledge of infrastructure as code (Terraform) and cloud platforms (AWS/EKS). Experience deploying and operating self-hosted LLM inference stacks (vLLM, NVIDIA Triton/NIM, TGI, Ollama, or similar) and GPU-backed infrastructure, including Kubernetes GPU scheduling and autoscaling. Familiarity with LLMOps practices: model versioning, evaluation harnesses, and usage and cost observability across API-based and self-hosted models. Track record of setting technical direction, driving cross-team initiatives, and mentoring other engineers; this role has significant scope and minimal day-to-day oversight. Clear, proactive communication skills, with the ability to explain infrastructure trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. Experience operating LLM and AI-assisted developer tooling at scale (Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) inside an enterprise is preferred. Familiarity with Okta/OIDC and enterprise auth patterns for internal platforms is preferred. Experience with engineering productivity metrics tooling (LinearB or similar) and AI-based code review tooling (Qodo or similar) is preferred. Experience with vector databases and RAG pipelines (for example Milvus, Pinecone, pgvector, or similar) in a production setting is preferred. Exposure to model fine-tuning or lightweight training pipelines (LoRA/QLoRA or similar) for domain-specific model adaptation is preferred. Why SentinelOne? AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. description: Job Description Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today. As we grow, that contribution becomes even more important. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to help you thrive. About the Role We are looking for a DevSecOps Engineer to implement and operate security checks in Azure DevOps and related delivery workflows. You will help engineering teams receive timely, accurate feedback on code, dependencies, secrets, infrastructure and deployed applications while maintaining the reliability of the supporting automation. The role combines pipeline engineering, troubleshooting, tool configuration, evidence automation and developer support. It is ideal for someone who enjoys making security controls usable and repeatable. Location: Hyderabad, India. This is an office-based position and is not available as a remote role. Key Duties and Responsibilities Implement and maintain Azure DevOps YAML templates, pipeline tasks, scripts and configuration for approved security capabilities. Configure SAST, SCA, secrets, IaC, container, DAST and API security checks at the pipeline stage defined by the control design. Onboard repositories and pipelines, verify prerequisites and permissions, test integrations and record coverage evidence. Troubleshoot scan failures, agent issues, network or authentication problems, API errors, timeouts and configuration drift. Normalise and route results to the correct application and owner; support deduplication, suppression review and ticket creation. Work with AppSec engineers to confirm which findings require manual triage, remediation tracking or validation. Collect baselines for report-only controls, analyse false positives and performance impact, and support pilots for risk-based blocking. Implement approved quality-gate rules and exception data; verify that bypasses are visible, authorised and time-bound. Maintain dashboards and evidence for tool health, adoption, coverage, scan outcomes, ageing findings and exceptions. Write clear onboarding guides, troubleshooting steps and FAQs; provide practical support to product engineering teams. Assist tool evaluations and proofs of concept by building integrations, running test suites and documenting detection and operational results. Apply version control, peer review, testing, secrets management and least privilege to security automation. Identify repetitive manual work and propose safe automation or reusable templates. Knowledge, Skills and Experience Typically 2-5 years in DevOps, software engineering, cloud engineering or security engineering, with hands-on CI/CD experience. Practical knowledge of Azure DevOps repositories and YAML pipelines, or strong experience with a comparable platform and the ability to transfer quickly. Scripting ability in Python, PowerShell, Bash or similar, including use of REST APIs and structured data formats. Experience with at least two of code scanning, dependency scanning, secrets detection, IaC scanning, container scanning, DAST or API testing. Understanding of Git workflows, build artefacts, dependencies, environment variables, credentials and least-privilege access. Systematic troubleshooting skills and the ability to document a problem, evidence and resolution clearly. Collaborative communication with developers and security reviewers. Fluent English, spoken and written. Additional Practical Experience Azure, Kubernetes, container registry or infrastructure-as-code experience. Experience creating dashboards or integrating findings with work-management or vulnerability-management systems. Familiarity with SBOMs, package ecosystems, licence risk or supply-chain security concepts. Practical experience delivering cloud, DevOps or security automation projects. Experience in financial services or another regulated environment. Candidate Expectations Build automation that is readable, tested and supportable by others. Investigate the cause of control failures rather than normalising bypasses. Balance fast feedback with accurate results and predictable pipeline performance. Escalate potential production impact, privilege concerns or policy ambiguity early. Work collaboratively and consistently from the Hyderabad office. description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Your role Full Stack AI Engineer. AI Solution Integration: Embed and configure Azure AI services into backend workflows, enabling intelligent features, data processing, and automation. API & Data Engineering: Develop high-performance REST-based web services, handling data mapping across relational and NoSQL databases using JSON and XML structures. Code Quality & Architecture: Apply object-oriented programming (OOP) principles, clean code standards, and design patterns to ensure enterprise-grade software stability and maintainability. DevOps & CI/CD Collaboration: Work alongside engineering teams to implement modern DevOps practices, automated testing, continuous integration, and seamless cloud deployments. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career. Your Future at Kyndryl Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required skills and Experience Full-Stack Core: 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building complex, robust software with strong frontend development in React and backend development in Python (with familiarity in languages such as Java or .NET). AI Capabilities: Proven practical experience integrating and leveraging Azure AI services. Databases & APIs: Deep understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, RESTful API design, and JSON/XML data serialization. Architecture & Distributed Systems: Solid knowledge of microservices architecture, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), messaging queues, OOP, and software design patterns. Problem-Solving: Proven track record in debugging complex distributed codebases and troubleshooting system performance issues. Preferred Skills and Experience Cloud Certifications (High Preference): Recognized certifications in major hyperscalers, particularly Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals / Azure Developer Associate, or equivalents in AWS/GCP. AI Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102) or related artificial intelligence credentials. DevOps Practices: Direct experience with modern DevOps toolchains, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure management. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Azure/Python/React)
description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Your role Full Stack AI Engineer. You will design, build, and deploy scalable, AI-powered enterprise software applications by integrating Azure AI services with robust Python backends and modern React user interfaces. In this role, you will bridge machine learning capabilities with end-to-end full-stack software development, architecting containerized microservices and responsive frontends that solve complex business problems. What you will do Full-Stack Application Development: Design, build, and optimize scalable web applications using React for frontend interfaces and Python for backend microservices. AI Solution Integration: Embed and configure Azure AI services into backend workflows, enabling intelligent features, data processing, and automation. API & Data Engineering: Develop high-performance REST-based web services, handling data mapping across relational and NoSQL databases using JSON and XML structures. Microservices & Containerization: Architect and deploy distributed services leveraging container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and message queuing systems. Code Quality & Architecture: Apply object-oriented programming (OOP) principles, clean code standards, and design patterns to ensure enterprise-grade software stability and maintainability. DevOps & CI/CD Collaboration: Work alongside engineering teams to implement modern DevOps practices, automated testing, continuous integration, and seamless cloud deployments. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career. Your Future at Kyndryl Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required skills and Experience Full-Stack Core: 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building complex, robust software with strong frontend development in React and backend development in Python (with familiarity in languages such as Java or .NET). AI Capabilities: Proven practical experience integrating and leveraging Azure AI services. Databases & APIs: Deep understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, RESTful API design, and JSON/XML data serialization. Architecture & Distributed Systems: Solid knowledge of microservices architecture, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), messaging queues, OOP, and software design patterns. Problem-Solving: Proven track record in debugging complex distributed codebases and troubleshooting system performance issues. Preferred Skills and Experience Cloud Certifications (High Preference): Recognized certifications in major hyperscalers, particularly Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals / Azure Developer Associate, or equivalents in AWS/GCP. AI Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102) or related artificial intelligence credentials. DevOps Practices: Direct experience with modern DevOps toolchains, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure management. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Product Support Engineer
description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries , Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively , including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - Product Support at Sprinto is not about forwarding queries or closing as many tickets as possible. It is about understanding why something is not working and helping the customer move forward with confidence. When a customer encounters an integration failure, unexpected API behaviour, configuration issue or confusing product workflow, you will investigate the problem, identify what is happening and own the issue through resolution. You will work with browser developer tools, APIs, integrations, logs and cloud environments. You will also collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success and Compliance teams. You will develop technical depth while learning how a global SaaS product operates in real customer environments. Where you'll leave your mark? Solve real technical problems : Investigate product, integration and configuration issues rather than relying only on predefined responses. Reproduce problems, test hypotheses and identify the most likely cause. Become fluent in modern SaaS systems : Develop practical knowledge of APIs, HTTP requests, browser behaviour, authentication, cloud integrations and the systems that connect Sprinto with a customer's technology environment. Own the customer's experience: Communicate clearly throughout the investigation. Help customers understand what happened, what is being done and what they should do next - without overwhelming them with unnecessary technical detail. Work closely with Product and Engineering: Collect the right evidence, isolate issues and create precise escalations that help engineering teams act quickly. Over time, you will learn to distinguish between product defects, configuration problems, integration failures and expected behaviour. Improve more than one interaction: Identify recurring patterns and turn them into better documentation, troubleshooting playbooks, product feedback or process improvements. A strong solution should help the next customer before they encounter the same problem. Build expertise in trust and security: Learn how businesses implement frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR and HIPAA, and how Sprinto connects with their cloud infrastructure, identity systems and business applications. The kind of builder we're looking for - You'll likely thrive in this position if: You have upto 1-2 year of relevant experience. Loves enjoy understanding how products and systems work - not merely following instructions. Comfortable about unfamiliar problems by breaking them down and testing possibilities. You have a working understanding of APIs, HTTP, client-server architecture and databases. Can explain a technical problem clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Very comfortable asking questions, researching independently and learning from incomplete information. Excited about taking ownership of an issue and follow it through instead of treating escalation as the end of your responsibility. You care about the customer's experience as much as the technical correctness of the answer. You communicate clearly in writing and work effectively in a remote environment. You respond well to feedback and demonstrate visible learning from one problem to the next. Prior experience in Product Support is not required. We care more about your learning agility, problem-solving ability, communication and technical curiosity. How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. title: Senior Cyber Security GRC Analyst
description: Role Introduction: We are seeking an experienced Senior Cybersecurity GRC Analyst to be responsible for cybersecurity risk assessment across OneAdvanced. The role reports to the Head of Cybersecurity Risk and Controls. You will carry out risk assessments, evaluate security controls and evidence, maintain the risk register, and report on risk and remediation progress. You will work with security, technology and business teams on cybersecurity risks. What You Will Do: Cybersecurity Risk Assessment & Management: Carry out cybersecurity risk assessments across applications, infrastructure, cloud services, technology processes and security operations. Identify threats, vulnerabilities and control gaps, and assess their likelihood and impact. Assess inherent and residual risk, taking into account the design and effectiveness of existing controls. Document risk statements, evidence and findings, and recommend treatment. Agree treatment plans with risk owners: mitigation, acceptance, transfer or avoidance. Risk Register & Lifecycle Management: Maintain the cyber risk register, including owners, ratings, treatment decisions, actions and review dates. Track remediation, validate progress and escalate overdue or material risks. Reassess risks when threats, systems, business exposure or controls change. Assess risk acceptance and security exception requests and make a recommendation. Security Control Assessment & Assurance: Evaluate security controls and evidence against internal policies and industry frameworks. Assess controls in areas such as identity and access management, vulnerability management, cloud and application security, incident response, resilience and data protection. Apply NIST CSF 2.0, CIS Controls, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 when assessing control gaps. Work with control owners on remediation and keep the supporting documentation. Risk Governance, Monitoring & Reporting: Prepare risk reports, dashboards and management updates on exposure, trends, exceptions and remediation progress. Provide input to cybersecurity risk reviews and governance forums. Monitor key risk indicators and flag emerging or changing exposures. Keep cyber risk records in line with enterprise risk management processes and internal methodology. Continuous Improvement & Process Enhancement: Improve risk assessment templates, scoring, control mapping and reporting. Use automation or AI tools where they help with evidence review, analysis and reporting. Contribute to the cyber risk methodology and control library. Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement: Work with security operations, engineering, application security, infrastructure, technology and business teams. Explain technical risks and treatment options to technical and non-technical stakeholders. What You Will Have: Skills and Experience: Minimum of 5 years in cybersecurity, including at least 4 years of hands-on cybersecurity risk management. Experience personally carrying out risk assessments, evaluating control gaps, documenting risk and tracking remediation, beyond audit or compliance coordination. Experience maintaining risk registers and managing risks through their lifecycle. Working knowledge of NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and SOC 2, applied in risk assessments and gap analysis. Technical understanding of identity and access management, vulnerability management, network, cloud and application security, incident response and resilience. Experience assessing inherent and residual risk and reviewing control evidence. Ability to turn technical findings into business risk and produce clear management reports. Strong analytical, documentation and communication skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities with limited supervision. title: Cyber Incident Response - Director - Cybersecurity Operations
description: Cyber Data Risk and Resilience (CDRR) is part of the Global Technology organization and manages technology related risks on behalf of the Firm. CDRR's mandate is to enable the Firm to manage its technology and data related risks through implementing proactive, comprehensive and consistent risk management practices across the Firm to protect the franchise while capturing business opportunities. Morgan Stanley is looking for experienced security professionals to join the Firm's Cyber Incident Response Team (CIRT) as a Cyber Incident Response Analyst. The global CIRT provides a 24/7 first point of contact for security related incidents within the firm. Its members monitor the Firm's environment for abnormal behaviour and potential security breaches. Analysts review, triage, and investigate security alerts, and respond to or escalate security incidents. What You'll Do In The Role Investigate cyber security incidents and threats. Interact with stakeholders and leadership teams as part of the response and remediation efforts. Improve the detection, escalation, containment and resolution of incidents. Enhance existing incident response methods, tools, and processes. Maintain knowledge of technologies and the threat landscape. Assist during non-core business hours during an emergency, critical or large-scale incident. Secondary Responsibilities VM Liaison Act as CIRT's primary point of contact with the Vulnerability Management team and engage with them on a regular basis. Maintain a current understanding of the status of vulnerabilities across the organization and be ready to lead or support investigations related to vulnerability exploitation. Translate vulnerability intelligence into actionable guidance for CIRT detection and response. Attack Surface Management Perform continuous discovery and mapping of the Firm's internal and external attack surface, including assets, services, domains, and cloud resources. Conduct vulnerability and exposure testing to identify misconfigurations, exposed services, and weaknesses. Feed attack surface insights into incident investigations and threat detection. What You'll Bring To The Role Candidates should have a genuine interest in cyber security and a good understanding of the tactics, techniques and procedures of attackers. This role requires a detail oriented, critical thinker who can anticipate issues and solve problems. Candidates should be able to analyze large datasets to detect underlying patterns and drive to a root cause analysis. 5+ years of experience (or equivalent) with Security Analysis and Incident Response (i.e. working in SOC/CIRT/CSIRT/CERT). Understand the concept of a threat across multiple technologies and think like an adversary. Sound understanding of TCP/IP and networking concepts; security alerts and incidents. Excellent writing and presentation skills are required in order to communicate findings and recommendations. Experience with investigating common types of attacks; network packet analysis; log analysis and reviewing security events. Experience applying Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) techniques in support of investigations. Knowledge on Windows processes and Active Directory. Able to work on extended working hours during incidents. Hands-on experience with vulnerability management processes, vulnerability research, and assessing vulnerability impact on enterprise systems. Hands-on experience in Attack Surface Management, including continuous discovery and mapping, vulnerability and exposure testing, and risk prioritization and triage. Desired Skills Experience investigating AI-assisted attacks is an advantage. Experience using AI to automate work or investigations is an advantage. Subject matter expert in one or multiple areas such as Windows, Unix, anti-virus, firewalls, intrusion detection, network and host based forensics. Scripting (Python, BASH, Perl, or PowerShell), coding or other development experience. In-depth knowledge of security event management, network security monitoring, log collection, and correlation. Experience in Splunk or Elastic usage or administration. Experience in Security Orchestration and Automated Response (SOAR) usage. Industry certifications: Incident Response: GCIH, GNFA, GREM or other related SANS certifications. Cloud security certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP security certifications, CCSP) are good to have. Vulnerability Management or Attack Surface Management related certifications are good to have. Experience in the financial industry. Understanding of Cloud Security. Knowledge on OWASP Top 10. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. title: Senior Security Operations Analyst
description: Job Title: Senior Security Operations Analyst About Trellix Trellix is a global cybersecurity leader helping organizations build cyber resilience for the AI era. Combining AI-native security, operational threat intelligence, and automated detection and response, Trellix provides defense-grade protection at machine speed across on-premises, air-gapped, operational technology, hybrid, and cloud environments. Trellix helps customers anticipate threats, scale effective security operations, maintain business continuity, and adapt their security posture for the modern threat landscape. Working with a broad partner ecosystem and global intelligence collaborators, Trellix helps strengthen the collective defense against cybercriminals and state-sponsored attacks. At Trellix, we empower professionals at all career stages to expand their technical expertise, lead strategic initiatives, and make a tangible global impact. Whether you are an industry pioneer or an emerging specialist, Trellix provides the tools and opportunities to enhance and expand your skill set. Join our mission to scale AI-driven cyber defense alongside an AI-accelerated threat landscape, and help build a safer, more resilient future. More at https://trellix.com. Role Overview: The SOC Cloud Security Operations Analyst serves as an escalation point within the Security Operations Center (SOC) and overall Fusion Center. This role is responsible for monitoring, investigating, and remediating complex security alerts, conducting detailed technical analysis, and collaborating across different environments to mitigate threats. The ideal candidate pairs traditional SOC triage expertise with modern working knowledge of Security AI/ML tools and deep hands-on expertise in multi-cloud infrastructure security across AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) About the Role : Incident Investigation & Escalation: Take full ownership of security incidents; validate findings, determine scope and impact, execute remediation, and drive root cause analysis. Multi-Cloud Security Operations: Monitor, investigate, and contain threats across hybrid and multi-cloud infrastructure environments (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI), utilizing native cloud security controls and centralized cloud security telemetry. AI-Enabled Threat Analysis: Leverage AI/ML-driven threat detection platforms, automated investigation tools, and LLM-assisted workflows to accelerate threat hunting, alert summarization, and query generation. Forensics & Malware Analysis: Perform technical triage, dynamic malware analysis, memory/artifact collection, and detailed log analysis across endpoint, network, and cloud telemetry. Vulnerability & Threat Management: Work in concert with Security Engineering and Product Security to prioritize and remediate active exploits, misconfigurations, and vulnerabilities. Global Handoffs & Mentorship: Lead seamless shift handoffs to global counterpart teams and provide ongoing mentoring and knowledge transfer Incident Documentation & Reporting: Author comprehensive incident reports, operational briefs, post-incident reviews, and tickets while ensuring evidence integrity for Incident Response workflows. About You : 4-6 years of direct operational security experience within an enterprise Security Operations Center (SOC) or Incident Response team acting as an escalation point (Tier II). Proven track record of handling high-severity incidents across both on-premises and enterprise multi-cloud environments. Cloud Security Infrastructure Expertise (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI) AWS Security: Hands-on experience investigating alerts from AWS Security Hub, Amazon GuardDuty, AWS CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, and IAM Policy/Permission boundaries. Microsoft Azure Security: Experience with Azure Sentinel, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Activity Logs, NSGs, and Entra ID (Azure AD) identity threat detection. Google Cloud (GCP) Security: Familiarity with GCP Security Command Center (SCC), Cloud Audit Logs, VPC Firewall rules, and IAM conditional bindings. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Security: Working knowledge of OCI Guardrail/Data Safe, OCI Audit Logs, Identity Domains, and OCI Network Security Groups (NSGs). Cloud Detection & Response (CDR): Solid understanding of cloud-native attack vectors (e.g., IAM credential abuse, metadata service exploitation, container escape, storage bucket misconfigurations, cross-cloud lateral movement). Artificial Intelligence & Operational AI Knowledge Working-Level Security AI Skills: Practical experience utilizing AI/ML-driven security tools (e.g., Security Copilot, AI-assisted EDR/SIEM features, automated triage playbooks). Prompt Engineering & Tooling: Ability to write effective natural language prompts to query security telemetry, generate KQL/SPL search strings, summarize complex threat reports, or analyze malicious scripts/code snippets. AI Risk Awareness: Basic understanding of security risks unique to AI integration (e.g., prompt injection, data leakage via LLMs, adversarial machine learning concepts). Core SOC & Technical Competencies Endpoint & Malware Analysis: Hands-on experience with enterprise EDR/XDR technology stacks (e.g., McAfee/Trellix, CrowdStrike, Defender for Endpoint) and dynamic malware analysis techniques. Network & OS Fundamentals: Deep technical understanding of OSI Model, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, SMTP, routing, and deep OS internals across Windows, Linux/Unix, and macOS. SIEM & Log Analysis: Expertise in querying and correlating enterprise SIEM telemetry, identifying pattern anomalies, and reducing false positives. Incident Handling Procedures: Demonstrated success executing NIST SP 800-61 / MITRE ATT&CK framework mapping during active containment and recovery phases. Soft Skills & Professional Attributes High-Pressure Execution: Proven ability to manage and prioritize multiple high-priority incidents under tight timelines. Strong Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; adept at presenting complex technical findings to both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders. Global Team Alignment: High initiative with a collaborative style suitable for cross-functional and globally distributed teams. Company Benefits and Perks: We believe that the best solutions are developed by teams who embrace each other's unique experiences, skills, and abilities. We work hard to create a dynamic workforce where we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees. Trellix conducts interviews through professional channels only and does not use text messages, instant messaging, or group chats for interviews. description: Use Your Power for Purpose At Pfizer, technology drives everything we do. You will play a pivotal role in implementing impactful and innovative technology solutions across all functions, from research to manufacturing. Whether you are digitizing drug discovery and development, identifying innovative solutions, or streamlining our processes, you will be making a significant impact on countless lives. ROLE SUMMARY Take the hardest AI problems in Finance & Global Business Services (GBS) from whiteboard to production, and set the patterns the rest of the team builds on. As Senior Manager, Forward Deployed Engineer, you join a Finance & GBS function team, define the problem, and lead the build from first prototype through production handoff and support. You take the engagements that span multiple systems or teams. You work on engagements in areas such as financial close, forecasting, accounts receivable, procure-to-pay, tax, treasury, shared services operations, and other F&GBS functions. We measure success through adoption and demonstrable business outcomes, including time saved, improved quality, reduced risk, stronger controls, faster cycle times, better decisions, and measurable financial impact, and by how much of your work the rest of the team can reuse. This is a senior hands-on individual contributor and technical lead role within the F&GBS Technology & AI Solutions Capability Center in Chennai. You set the engineering patterns other Forward Deployed Engineers follow, review their designs and code, and still write code every week. You work alongside Product Owners, function leaders, finance analysts, process owners, and Digital platform and architecture teams. WHY THIS ROLE You work directly with Finance and GBS leaders worldwide, so you find out fast whether what you build works. You lead the design of agentic AI built with frontier models on Pfizer’s enterprise AI platforms, connected to SAP, Snowflake, Oracle EPM, and custom solutions through MCP or direct API integration. You help shape a shared F&GBS Data & AI Foundation (ontology, rules engine, MCP tool library, and decision ledger), and decide which patterns become shared building blocks. Your influence grows through technical leadership and the patterns others reuse. You can grow your career without moving into people management. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Problem Discovery & Business Partnership Work in person in Chennai within the F&GBS Technology & AI Solutions Capability Center, while embedding virtually with assigned Finance and GBS teams. Lead discovery for complex, cross-functional use cases through regular calls, screen-share walkthroughs, and process reviews, and shape them into roadmaps with measurable outcomes. Run discovery with senior business stakeholders and process owners across regions, including the US and Europe. Work with Product Owners to turn priorities and specifications into solution designs and delivery plans, and to rank use cases by value, feasibility, and risk. Say no, or not yet, when a use case lacks data, sponsorship, or a clear value case, and push back when a specification doesn’t match the underlying problem or runs into technical issues and limitations. Technical Leadership & Build Serve as technical lead on complex engagements. Own solution design and stay hands-on in the code. Design multi-agent and multi-step workflows on Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI, and other market-leading runtimes, using frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, and LangChain, with MCP, A2A, and APIs connecting enterprise systems, deterministic business rules, and human approval steps. Set coding standards, evaluation practice, and quality bars for the engagements you lead, including review standards for AI-generated code. Use AI coding agents in your daily workflow to speed delivery, and show other engineers how to use them well. Make build-versus-buy and platform choices with Digital platform and architecture teams. Data & Enterprise Integration Lead integration across Finance and GBS data and systems through governed MCP tools or APIs and certified data products, such as SAP S/4HANA, Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, SAP Ariba and Business Network, Oracle EPM, Microsoft 365, and other enterprise platforms. Define data contracts, semantic models, and access patterns, and extend the shared F&GBS ontology and business rules (such as Delegation of Authority, Segregation of Duties, and materiality) that other engineers and agents reuse. Set data access, entitlement, and classification practice for financial and personal data on the engagements you lead. Controls, Compliance & Responsible AI Own control design for your solutions. Engage SOX, Internal Audit, Privacy, Legal, Security, and AI governance early, including data privacy (GDPR, India DPDP Act) and EU AI Act review, and pass required gates before release. Define evaluation and monitoring for accuracy, drift, and failure modes on financial outputs, and make sure agent evidence, approvals, and actions are recorded in the decision ledger. Enforce Pfizer responsible AI safeguards: data access controls, prompt injection defenses, human review, and output monitoring. Production, Reliability & Reuse Own production readiness and ongoing support for the solutions you lead: LLMOps practice, deployment pipelines, monitoring, incident response, and run costs. Establish support ownership, runbooks, service expectations, escalation paths, knowledge transfer, and root cause analysis for production solutions. Set the standard for logging, tracing, monitoring, and alerting with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Foundry Observability. Convert proven solutions into reusable components, templates, and accelerators across Finance and GBS. Identify and pay down technical debt before it blocks scale. Mentoring & Practice Building Mentor Manager-level FDEs, and engineers in F&GBS function teams, through design reviews, pairing, and code review. Contribute to FDE playbooks, interview loops, and team upskilling. Value & Adoption Build business cases and track realized value: hours saved, cycle time, cost avoidance, and risk reduction. Present results and tradeoffs to senior Finance and GBS stakeholders and FDE leadership. Build champions in the business so adoption sticks. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS You can partner with the business, turn messy problems into working solutions, and show the impact in numbers. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, with [9+] years of software or data engineering experience. 3+ years building and shipping LLM-based applications to production, including at least one multi-step agentic system with tool use, evaluation, and monitoring. Technical lead experience on complex, multi-system builds. Expert-level Python, with strong TypeScript/JavaScript and SQL. Hands-on experience with Azure (preferred) or AWS cloud architecture, API-first design, CI/CD, and observability. Hands-on LLMOps practice: evaluation, tracing, and prompt, model, and agent versioning. Proven ability to influence senior business stakeholders without formal authority. Experience mentoring engineers. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Master’s degree in a technical field, or a finance/accounting background combined with engineering experience. Deep knowledge of finance processes such as record-to-report, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, FP&A, or treasury, or prior work in finance technology. Experience integrating with SAP (S/4HANA, GTS, Ariba), Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, the Azure AI stack (AI Foundry, AI Search, Document Intelligence, Azure ML), Vertex AI, or Oracle EPM. Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, LangChain), MCP server development, and A2A. Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or rules engines. Experience with SOX and IT general controls in a regulated industry. Experience turning bespoke solutions into reusable platforms or products. Relevant certifications (AWS or Azure Solutions Architect or Developer, or equivalent on other market-leading platforms). You don’t need every item on this list. If you’ve led AI into production that people use and you want to work close to the business, we want to hear from you. NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL, OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS Regular overlap with US and European time zones is required, including some early-evening IST calls. Must be able to travel to Pfizer offices and partner sites when required, including occasional international travel. Work can be demanding at times, including support during period-end close and leading the response to production incidents. Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers. Information & Business Tech

description: Saviynt's AI-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit www.saviynt.com. We are building a next-generation Security Operations Center (SOC) designed for the AI-first era. We are moving beyond traditional reactive methods to build an intelligent, automated SOC that leverages deep cloud security expertise to stop advanced threats. We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented L2 SOC Analyst to be a core member of our 24/7 operations team. This role is for a hands-on analyst who excels at investigating complex alerts, using automation to accelerate response, and is passionate about cloud security. You will be the primary line of in-depth analysis, working to validate, investigate, and contain threats as they are escalated from L1. Please note: This is a 24/7 operational role. The SOC team works in three rotating shifts (morning, afternoon, and night) to ensure continuous monitoring and response. What You Will Be Doing Incident Triage & Investigation Serve as the primary escalation point for alerts triaged by L1 analysts. Conduct detailed analysis of security alerts from a wide range of sources (SIEM, EDR, CSPM, Cloud-native tools) to validate threats and determine their scope. Investigate security incidents in our enterprise and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), correlating data to build a complete picture of attacker activity. Perform deep-dive analysis of logs, kubernetes containers, and endpoint data to identify indicators of compromise (IOCs). Incident Response & Automation Execute and tune automated response playbooks using our SOAR platform for common security incidents. Perform timely incident response actions, such as isolating compromised hosts, blocking malicious IPs/domains, and disabling compromised accounts. Utilize and modify existing scripts (primarily Python) to assist with automated evidence collection and enrichment. Document all investigation steps, findings, and containment actions in our incident management system. Threat Hunting & Cloud Monitoring Participate in hypothesis based threat hunting campaigns based on new threat intelligence or hypotheses developed by senior analysts. Actively monitor and analyze security logs from cloud-native tools (e.g., AWS GuardDuty, CloudTrail,Cloudflare, Azure,etc.) and kubernetes containers. Assist in tuning detection rules and identifying false positives to help improve the fidelity of our security alerts. Continuous Improvement & Collaboration Escalate complex, high-severity, or unresolved incidents to L3 Analysts and the Incident Response team with detailed handover notes. Contribute to the refinement of SOC documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and investigation runbooks. Provide guidance and mentorship to L1 analysts on triage techniques and alert analysis. What You Bring Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Willingness and ability to work in a 24/7 rotational shift environment (morning, afternoon, and night). 4-6 years of experience in a Security Operations (SOC) environment, with demonstrated L2 capabilities. Cloud & Container Security Experience: Hands-on experience monitoring and responding to alerts in at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP); fundamental knowledge on container security Technical Expertise: Strong, hands-on experience with SIEM (e.g., CrowdStrike, Splunk, QRadar, Azure Sentinel) and EDR (e.g., CrowdStrike, SentinelOne) platforms. AI/Automation Familiarity: Experience using a SOAR platform and familiarity with AI tools and their practical implementation. Strong working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and its application to incident analysis. Why Join Us Be at the forefront of a modern, cloud-focused Security Operations Center. Gain deep, hands-on experience with cutting-edge cloud security, automation, and threat intelligence technologies. A clear career path for growth into L3, threat hunting, or automation engineering roles. Collaborate with world-class security and engineering leaders in a high-impact, operational role. Saviynt is an amazing place to work. We are a high-growth, Platform as a Service company focused on Identity Authority to power and protect the world at work. You will experience tremendous growth and learning opportunities through challenging yet rewarding work which directly impacts our customers, all within a welcoming and positive work environment. If you're resilient and enjoy working in a dynamic environment you belong with us! Risk Governance, Monitoring & Reporting: Prepare risk reports, dashboards and management updates on exposure, trends, exceptions and remediation progress. Provide input to cybersecurity risk reviews and governance forums. Monitor key risk indicators and flag emerging or changing exposures. Cross-compilation with GCC/Clang toolchains, Make, CMake . Networking & Integration TCP/IP, TLS/SSL, OpenSSL Serial (RS-232), USB, and peripheral communication protocols. REST API and JSON integration; client-server error handling. Development Tools Git, Postman, Jira VS Code, Eclipse CDT, or NetBeans Software Engineering Skills Excellent debugging and troubleshooting on target hardware. Ability to work across application, payment, network, and device layers. Experience with the full SDLC, code reviews, testing, and release processes. Comfortable in a fast-paced product development environment. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics, or a related field . 7+ years of professional software development experience. Previous experience in payment, banking, fintech, retail, POS, acquiring, or transaction-processing systems . title: Senior System engineer - Patching & Vulnerability
description: Job Description About the Role: We are seeking a Systems Engineer to own patch management, configuration automation and vulnerability remediation across our Linux server and endpoint fleet. This role uses Puppet/Ansible-based automation for Linux OS patching and configuration enforcement, ensuring systems stay compliant, secure, and up to date with minimal manual intervention. Key Responsibilities — Linux (Puppet/Ansible) Manage end-to-end patch lifecycle (assessment, testing, staged rollout, validation) across RHEL servers. Develop, maintain, and version-control Puppet/Ansible modules and manifests for OS patching, software installation, and configuration enforcement. Design staged/canary patch rollout groups to minimize production risk. Automate software installation and configuration across environments to reduce manual provisioning. Troubleshoot patch failures, configuration drift, and Puppet/Ansible run errors across the fleet. Lead remediation of End-of-Life (EOL) / End-of-Support (EOS) operating systems and software — upgrading, re platforming, or migrating affected servers ahead of support cutoff dates. Execute EOL remediation plans in coordination with infrastructure and application owners, escalating and documenting formal risk acceptance only where remediation isn't feasible within the required timeline. Shared Responsibilities — Vulnerability Management & Compliance Prioritize and remediate critical/high findings within SLA. Define and manage maintenance windows, rollback procedures, and exception/risk-acceptance workflows for unpatchable systems. Collaborate with security and application teams to align patch cadence with compliance requirements (CIS Benchmarks, STIG, PCI, etc.). Document processes, runbooks, and standard operating procedures for patch, configuration, and remediation management. Required Qualifications — Linux Minimum 3+ years of Linux systems administration experience (RHEL). Hands-on experience with Puppet/Ansible (manifests, modules, Hiera, PuppetDB, r10k or similar control-repo workflow). Experience with package management (yum/dnf, apt). Hands-on experience remediating EOL/EOS operating systems and software — performing OS upgrades, migrations, or replatforming to bring systems back into supported status. Required Qualifications — Shared Scripting proficiency in Bash and/or Python. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong communication and teamwork abilities. Preferred Qualifications Experience with patch orchestration tools (Red Hat Satellite, Spacewalk, or equivalent). Familiarity with vulnerability management/scanning tools (Qualys or similar). Understanding of CIS Benchmarks, STIG, or other security hardening standards. Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar). Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or higher; Puppet/Ansible Certified Professional. Experience in a regulated industry (financial services, healthcare) with formal exception/risk-acceptance processes. Experience running EOL remediation projects at scale (e.g., fleet-wide OS version upgrades, distro migrations) in coordination with cross-functional teams. Familiarity with Ansible or other configuration management tools as a secondary skill. Experience building compliance dashboards (Grafana, Splunk, or similar). ROLE SUMMARY We are seeking an Oracle Security Administrator for American Campus Communities (ACC), a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This is a regular, full-time, exempt corporate role based in Bengaluru, India and hired through Revantage India. The administrator reports to the Manager, IT Support. The Oracle Security Administrator owns the design, administration and governance of security within ACC's Oracle Cloud applications environment, including role design, entitlement assignment, segregation of duties, privileged access, access reviews and the audit evidence that proves it was all done correctly. This is a controls role as much as a technical one: the administrator builds least-privilege roles that still let Finance, Accounting, Procurement and Human Resources do their jobs, and remediates conflicting access before an auditor or an incident finds it. Working hours will provide meaningful daily overlap with US Central Time. The role also participates in rotating on-call coverage for US nights and weekends, supports Oracle quarterly update windows, access review cycles and audit deadlines, and provides coverage on US and India holidays to support uninterrupted operations. PRIMARY ROLE Design, build, test and maintain Oracle Cloud application security using the Security Console, including custom job roles, duty roles, aggregate privileges, role hierarchies and function and data security policies. Build roles to least privilege from business-process requirements rather than copying delivered roles, and document the business justification for every custom role. Administer data security, including data access sets, business unit and ledger-level security and security profiles, and maintain OTBI and BI Publisher reporting security. Maintain a controlled role catalog with naming standards, ownership and a documented change trail, and continually rationalize duplicate, unused, over-privileged and orphaned roles. Administer the Oracle user and role-assignment lifecycle, including provisioning, modification, transfer and timely termination, strictly in accordance with approved request and approval workflow and in coordination with the IAM team. Maintain identity integration with Microsoft Entra ID, including single sign-on and automated provisioning, and monitor role provisioning rules for unintended grants. Plan, execute and document periodic user access reviews and recertification campaigns with business owners, including follow-through on revocations. Reconcile Oracle access against HR records to detect accounts for terminated, transferred or dormant users. Govern service, integration and interface accounts, and administer privileged and emergency (break-glass) access with pre-approval, time limits, monitoring and after-the-fact review. Own the Oracle segregation of duties ruleset and perform conflict analysis on both current access and proposed changes before they are implemented. Administer access control and risk tooling (Oracle Risk Management Cloud / Advanced Access Controls or equivalent), remediate conflicts through role redesign, and document mitigating controls where conflicts cannot be eliminated. Restrict sensitive access, including bank account, vendor master, payment, journal entry, HR and payroll and security administration capabilities, to the minimum necessary population. Monitor for and investigate inappropriate or anomalous access and activity, escalating to Information Security per the incident response process. Produce access, change and privileged-activity evidence for internal and external audit and SOX or equivalent IT general control testing, and serve as the primary respondent for Oracle access questions during audits. Track Oracle access audit findings and control deficiencies through remediation to validated closure. Assess each Oracle quarterly update for security impact, regression test custom roles after every update and remediate before production cutover. Maintain tenant-level security settings, govern API and integration access, and ensure sensitive data is masked and access restricted in non-production environments. Follow change management for all security changes; no undocumented production security changes. Train requesters, approvers and reviewers so access requests arrive correct and access reviews are performed meaningfully rather than rubber-stamped. Document and maintain security design, provisioning procedures and control narratives sufficient for an auditor or successor to follow. Maintain a strong working knowledge of Oracle Cloud security capabilities, access governance practices and audit expectations, and communicate relevant improvements to team members and leadership. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Proficiency in the secure and responsible use of generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot and Gemini, including never exposing user access data, role configuration, audit findings or financial and personal data to unapproved tools. Experience securing AI-enabled applications and services by applying identity, authentication, authorization, privileged-access and governance practices to AI workloads and platforms, including AI capabilities embedded in the ERP. In-depth knowledge of the Oracle Cloud security model, including privileges, duty roles, job roles, aggregate privileges, data security policies and security profiles. Strong knowledge of segregation of duties principles, common financial and procurement conflict patterns and the design of defensible mitigating controls. Strong knowledge of IAM concepts and role-based access control methods, including least privilege, joiner-mover-leaver lifecycle and single sign-on with Microsoft Entra ID. Working knowledge of IT general controls, access governance and audit evidence expectations in a financial systems environment. Reporting and query skills sufficient to extract and analyze access data using OTBI, BI Publisher and SQL. Experience with ITIL-aligned change and incident management and with IT service-management platforms; ServiceNow is preferred. Excellent written and verbal business-English communication skills, with the ability to translate between auditor, accounting and Oracle security language across cultures and time zones. Ability to say no to an access request that creates a conflict or exceeds least privilege, and explain the reasoning in business terms. Ability to hold the line on documentation and approval requirements under time pressure, including during close and audit deadlines. Ability to operate with discretion and integrity while holding broad visibility into sensitive data and high-privilege access. Strong problem-solving and data-analysis skills, including analyzing large access data sets and reaching sound conclusions about risk. Ability to think logically and work effectively both independently and as part of a team. EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE At least five years of experience in application security administration, access governance or IT audit, including at least three years administering security in Oracle Cloud applications (ERP and/or HCM). Hands-on experience building custom job and duty roles in the Oracle Security Console, including function and data security policy configuration. Demonstrated experience performing segregation of duties analysis and remediation in a financial application and documenting mitigating controls. description: Experience - 5 to 6 years relevant Key Responsibilities Perform scheduled and emergency OS patching for Windows and Linux servers.
