description: Company Description CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER. It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers. Job Description We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (7+ Years of experience) to provide hands-on technical leadership and advanced production support for our retail technology ecosystem. The role is accountable for application stability, integration reliability, complex incident resolution, and continuous engineering improvements that keep retail, payment, hospitality, and connected business workflows running effectively. The scope includes Predict POS, Predict CMS, Avalara, Adyen, Agilence, Zomato, Shopper Track, Look Book, Bar Tender, IBM DOM, InfoGenesis, Stripe, and their associated integrations and business workflows. The engineer will work with business teams, support engineers, development teams, infrastructure teams, and vendors to restore services, address recurring issues, and deliver reliable production changes. Key Responsibilities Production Support and Technical Ownership Provide senior-level L2/L3 application and integration support across the supported ecosystem; own complex issues from diagnosis through recovery and validation. Monitor application health, transaction flows, APIs, scheduled jobs, data exchanges, and critical dependencies; identify failures and business impact before they cause wider disruption. Troubleshoot retail and hospitality workflows, including sales, returns, refunds, pricing, promotions, tax calculation, order processing, fulfillment, and reconciliation, as applicable to the deployed integrations. Investigate payment authorization, capture, cancellation, refund, settlement, and reconciliation issues across Adyen, Stripe, and connected POS or commerce workflows. Trace issues across application logs, databases, APIs, middleware, files, and connectivity; diagnose data mismatches, delayed processing, duplicate transactions, and failed interfaces. Incident and Problem Management Lead technical investigation during major incidents, coordinate internal teams and vendors, communicate impact and recovery progress, and drive resolution within agreed service levels. Own root-cause analysis for critical and recurring incidents; implement or coordinate permanent fixes and verify that corrective actions prevent recurrence. Manage vendor escalations with clear technical evidence, business impact, workarounds, and follow-through to resolution. Engineering and Integration Reliability Develop and maintain support utilities, scripts, and approved application or integration fixes using version control, peer review, and appropriate testing. Improve monitoring, alerting, transaction validation, and reconciliation controls; automate repeatable operational tasks and reduce manual intervention. Review interface error handling, retries, recovery procedures, and data integrity controls; ensure failed transactions can be investigated and safely reprocessed through approved procedures. Key Responsibilities Continued Release Readiness and Operational Leadership Review production changes for dependencies, business impact, test evidence, implementation steps, rollback plans, and required approvals; support sprint releases and emergency fixes. Perform smoke testing and end-to-end post-deployment validation across affected applications, integrations, and payment flows; coordinate recovery when validation fails. Drive production readiness for new applications, integrations, store rollouts, and critical retail events, including monitoring, capacity inputs, support coverage, and knowledge transfer. Mentor engineers, review technical investigations and runbooks, and improve support practices across the team without requiring formal people-management responsibility. Maintain SOPs, integration documentation, troubleshooting guides, escalation paths, and recovery procedures; support access reviews, audit evidence, and approved data or configuration corrections. Follow organizational security, privacy, and payment-data handling requirements; Participate in rotational shifts, weekend support, and on-call coverage as required. Required Skills and Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 7+ years of relevant software engineering, application support, or production operations experience, including ownership of complex incidents and production improvements. Strong experience supporting retail, POS, payments, eCommerce, order management, or hospitality platforms and their integrations in business-critical environments. Strong troubleshooting skills across APIs, application logs, SQL databases, batch jobs, and integration data flows; ability to diagnose issues across multiple systems. Practical understanding of POS transaction lifecycles, payment processing, tax-related transaction issues, and financial reconciliation. Hands-on SQL and scripting or programming skills for diagnostics, automation, and maintainable production fixes; experience with Git, code reviews, and CI/CD practices. Experience with Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management, release validation, monitoring, and vendor coordination. Ability to lead technical investigations, assess business impact, mentor engineers, and communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders. Qualifications Preferred Platform and Technical Experience Hands-on experience with one or more of Predict POS, Predict CMS, Avalara, Adyen, Agilence, Zomato, Shopper Track, Look Book, Bar Tender, IBM DOM, InfoGenesis, or Stripe is highly desirable. Candidates should be able to learn and support the broader ecosystem and its dependencies. Additional strengths include REST APIs, webhooks, file-based integrations, middleware or messaging, SaaS operations, observability tools, and secure payment operations. Familiarity with ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence, GitLab/GitHub, ITIL practices, and high-volume retail environments is preferred. Key Success Measures Application availability, payment reliability, and successful completion of critical retail and integration workflows. Incident SLA adherence, reduced recovery time, fewer recurring failures, and timely closure of root-cause corrective actions. Successful releases, effective vendor resolution, and operational readiness during peak trading periods. Improved monitoring and automation, current support documentation, stronger team capability, and adherence to access and change controls. **Comfortable with rotational shifts (includes night shifts as well)** Additional Information Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. How We Work: We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors: We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower. We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking. We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results. Our Approach to Flexible Work: We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter. Who We Are: Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more. Visit us at https://jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers. Mattel is an Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers, and all applicants will receive consideration for employment. Videos to watch: The Culture at Mattel Corporate Philanthropy

About the Role We are looking for an offensive security engineer to deliver authorised internal penetration tests of applications and APIs and to support broader red-team exercises. You will combine structured methodology with manual curiosity to find weaknesses that scanners and standard control checks miss. The role requires disciplined evidence, safe testing and clear reporting. You will work within approved rules of engagement and escalate immediately if test activity could affect service, data or users. Location: Hyderabad, India. This is an office-based position and is not available as a remote role. Key Duties and Responsibilities Execute internal web application and API penetration tests using approved methodologies, test plans and rules of engagement. Test authentication, session management, authorisation, input handling, data exposure, file processing, API object access and workflow controls. Develop misuse and abuse cases from business processes, user roles and trust assumptions; explore ways legitimate functionality could be manipulated. Use interception proxies, API clients, fuzzers, scanners and scripts to support—not replace—manual analysis. Inspect client-side code, API documentation, requests, responses and relevant source or configuration where access is approved. Document reproducible steps, requests and responses, affected roles, preconditions, impact and safe proof of exploitability. Remove false positives and duplicates, apply the severity methodology and seek peer review for high-risk or ambiguous findings. Prepare clear technical reports and concise summaries; explain findings to development teams without relying on jargon. Retest remediated findings and record whether the original attack path and relevant variants are closed. Support senior testers during objective-led red-team or purple-team exercises, including evidence capture and controlled validation. Create small scripts, test data and harnesses to improve repeatability; keep tooling approved, updated and securely stored. Share recurring vulnerabilities and root causes with AppSec engineers so guidance, threat models and pipeline controls can improve. Maintain accurate engagement status, evidence location, finding records and handover notes. Knowledge, Skills and Experience Typically 2-5 years in penetration testing, application security or security testing, with demonstrable hands-on web or API testing. Good understanding of HTTP, web architecture, REST APIs, cookies/tokens, authentication, authorisation and common vulnerability classes. Practical experience with an interception proxy and API-testing tools, plus basic scripting in Python, PowerShell, Bash or similar. Ability to distinguish a theoretical weakness from a reproducible, impactful security finding. Clear report writing with accurate evidence, remediation guidance and professional communication. Understanding of testing safety, confidentiality, approvals and responsible handling of credentials and sensitive data. Ability to receive peer review positively and improve testing based on feedback. Fluent English, spoken and written. Additional Practical Experience Evidence of practical offensive security development through hands-on labs, testing projects or structured training. Experience testing GraphQL, gRPC, mobile back ends, single-page applications or modern identity protocols. Exposure to Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, containers or CI/CD security. Secure code review or software development experience. Experience in financial services or another regulated environment. Candidate Expectations Stay within scope and use safe proofs; immediately report unexpected access or service impact. Test the business process, not only the endpoint or vulnerability checklist. Write with precision and avoid inflated severity or unsupported claims. Collaborate respectfully with the teams whose systems are being tested. Develop your tradecraft through deliberate practice and active participation from the Hyderabad office. title: Go-to-Market Global Operations, Sales Tools & Technologies Product Owner
description: Our Company: At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. A) Who You’ll Work With On our team, we build and run the systems that help Teradata’s sellers, marketers, services teams, and partners win and serve customers. Salesforce is the system of record for our go-to-market engine, spanning accounts, opportunities, pipeline, forecasting, quoting, and customer engagement. You will own that platform as a product. You will partner closely with Sales, Sales Operations and Revenue Operations, Marketing, Customer Success, Global Services, Finance, Legal and Privacy, and Technology Services platform administrators and developers. You will also work alongside other product owners on the Business Technology team to keep Salesforce integrated with the broader systems landscape, including Workday, CPQ, ERP/Finance, marketing automation, and learning systems. This position reports to the Senior Manager, Business Technology. B) What You’ll Do As the Salesforce Product Owner, you will translate business and user needs into clear, prioritized requirements, guide delivery in an agile model, and measure whether the platform is improving how Teradata sells and serves. Success means a Salesforce environment that is reliable, easy to use, well governed, and visibly tied to revenue and productivity outcomes. Key responsibilities: Support the execution of the Salesforce product roadmap and backlog, prioritizing features, enhancements, and fixes based on business value, user impact, and risk. Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria; lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and daily scrums with platform admins, developers, and implementation partners. Own requirements across Salesforce clouds and capabilities in use (such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ, reporting and forecasting, and Agentforce/AI features), including release readiness and user acceptance testing. Own requirements for integrations with adjacent systems, including SSO (Microsoft Entra ID), Workday, CPQ, ERP/Finance, Microsoft 365 and Teams, marketing automation, and data platforms; coordinate design, testing, and release. Partner with Sales and Revenue Operations to streamline lead-to-cash and opportunity-to-quote processes, reducing manual effort and improving data quality and forecast accuracy. Define and maintain data standards, object and field governance, and metadata ownership; oversee data quality, deduplication, and hygiene for accounts, contacts, and opportunities. Drive adoption and governance of AI-enabled capabilities, including usage controls, cost tracking, and responsible-use guardrails. Build and track platform KPIs (user adoption, data quality, process cycle time, release quality, user satisfaction) and deliver reporting and dashboards to stakeholders and leadership. Run intake and triage for enhancement requests and incidents, manage the Salesforce vendor and implementation partner relationships, and publish release notes. Manage the Salesforce seasonal release cycle, evaluating new functionality and sequencing change to minimize disruption and maximize adoption. Partner with Legal, Privacy, Security, and Compliance to keep the platform aligned with data protection requirements, access controls, and regional obligations. Create admin and end-user enablement, and support change management and communications for platform updates. C) What Makes You a Qualified Candidate Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 4–6 years of experience in product ownership, business systems, or CRM, including at least 2 years owning, administering, or configuring Salesforce in an enterprise environment. Hands-on experience managing a product backlog and writing user stories in an agile/Scrum environment. Working knowledge of the Salesforce data model, declarative configuration (Flow, validation rules, permission sets), and integration patterns including REST/SOAP APIs, SSO/SAML, and middleware. Strong analytical skills; able to build Salesforce reports and dashboards, interpret pipeline and adoption data, and turn metrics into decisions. Proven stakeholder management across business, IT, and vendor teams, with the ability to balance competing priorities and say no with data. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presenting to senior leaders. D) What You’ll Bring Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), or similar certification. Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Platform App Builder, Sales Cloud Consultant, or CPQ Specialist (strongly preferred). Experience with CRM implementations, migrations, or multi-org consolidation, and with quote-to-cash processes. Familiarity with AI and generative AI capabilities in CRM (such as Agentforce and Einstein), and interest in applying them responsibly. Experience with Jira, ServiceNow, and reporting tools such as Power BI or SQL. Understanding of data privacy requirements (e.g., GDPR) as they apply to customer and prospect data. Exposure to Workday, CPQ, ERP/Finance, or Microsoft 365 integrations. A customer- and seller-first, systems-oriented mindset, and the initiative to keep making the platform better. By owning Salesforce, you will directly shape how Teradata’s teams sell, serve, and succeed. #LI-TC1

title: Team Lead, Builder Developer III
description: ECI is rebuilding how software gets built: small teams of AI-first engineers, called Builders, who direct AI agents to design, ship, test and operate features end to end, measured in hours and days rather than sprints. As a Builder Manager, you lead that shift for an ECI India product team. You are not a ticket dispatcher or a status collector. You build the team, set the bar, and stay close enough to the code and the AI agents to know when the output is right and when it only looks right. WHAT IS A BUILDER AT ECI? At ECI, "Builder" is our title for engineers who work AI-first. Instead of writing every line by hand or working ticket by ticket, Builders direct AI agents to design, code, test and operate software, and are accountable for checking that the result is correct and safe in production. Builders work across Development, QA and Data. Builders work in pods: small, cross-functional teams (typically a handful of people) that own a product area end to end, from understanding the customer problem to running the feature in production. Builders grow along a four-level career framework. Levels reflect scope, independence and how much leverage someone gets from AI, not years of experience: Level 1: delivers well-defined work using AI tools, with coaching. Level 2: independently builds and runs AI agents and automated workflows for their features. Level 3 (Senior): sets technical direction for a product area; designs the testing, evaluation and safety checks that keep AI-built software reliable. Level 4 (Expert): shapes how AI-first engineering works across the whole organization. Every Builder is also assessed on five core competencies: Ownership, Delivery Reliability, Continuous Learning, Customer Orientation, and Communication & Collaboration. This role leads a team of Builders and is expected to operate at Level 3 or above. WHAT YOU WILL OWN 1. Product delivery, AI-first Own your product's engineering outcomes: what ships, at what quality, and how fast. Run delivery AI-first, in short cycles rather than two-week sprint rituals. Partner with product leadership to turn customer problems into well-scoped pieces of work with clear acceptance criteria and automated checks (evals) that prove the AI-built result is correct. Own production health: reliability, incident response, and DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, recovery time). 2. Build and grow the team Hire Builders at ECI's deliberately high bar, including a live, hands-on build exercise and assessment against the Builder career framework. Move an existing engineering team to the Builder way of working: assess each person against the framework, set clear development paths, and act decisively where someone isn't making the shift. Coach each person on the five core competencies, and grow Builders from one level to the next. Build the team's shared tooling and agent patterns, and lead across disciplines: Development, QA and Data Builders working as one team. De-risk the team's commitments, not just your own: spot fragile plans early and restructure them before they slip. 3. Engineering and AI standards Make AI the default in how the team builds, tests, documents and debugs, using tools such as Claude, Cursor and ECI's internal AI developer platform across the full lifecycle. Set the guardrails that keep speed safe: test coverage, code review of agent output, evals, feature flags and rollback. Govern AI systems in production with agent-level metrics alongside DORA: success and fallback rates, cost per task, retries, latency and user corrections. Keep agent behavior bounded through regression evals, versioning and human review. Modernize legacy code and workflows, treating them as a map of user intent to extract and automate. Keep AI usage measurable: attributed commits, Jira-linked work, and cost per outcome. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Must have 10+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years leading engineering teams in a product company. Hands-on, current AI-first development experience: you direct AI agents in your own work, and can show what you built and how you verified it. Has built and run multi-agent workflows in production (e.g. LangGraph or similar) and designed evals for agents that change frequently. Credible technical depth to review agent-generated code and challenge architecture: modern web/SaaS stacks, APIs, SQL, CI/CD, cloud. [Add product stack specifics.] A track record of raising a team's bar: hiring well, coaching through change, and handling under-performance directly. Clear, evidenced strength in at least two of the five core competencies listed above. Delivery and production ownership: you have run releases, incidents and postmortems, and you manage with metrics. Clear communication with US product and leadership counterparts across time zones. Experience modernizing a legacy product while it continues to serve customers. Nice to have AI-driven test automation or synthetic test data generation at scale. Background in vertical SaaS or ERP software. How you work Player-coach: close enough to the work to grade it, without becoming the bottleneck. Rigor over hype: you know the difference between a compelling AI demo and production-grade software. Ownership: you close loops and never escalate without a recommendation. No surprises: you surface risk early and honestly.

Create and maintain clear test scenarios and test cases covering positive, negative, boundary and recovery conditions. Prepare test data and configure required devices, accounts, subscriptions and environments. Execute functional, integration, system, regression, compatibility and end-to-end tests. Record results accurately, report coverage gaps and escalate blockers early. Retest resolved defects and run focused regression for impacted workflows. API Cloud and Data Validation Test REST APIs using tools such as Postman and automation libraries. Validate request and response data, status codes, authentication, authorization and error handling. Verify consistency across APIs, backend services, database records and user interfaces. Test asynchronous operations, events and notifications with support from senior engineers. Use AWS logs, dashboards and application telemetry to investigate test failures. Perform smoke and regression validation in QA and staging environments. Use ping, traceroute, nslookup or dig, iperf, browser developer tools and device or cloud logs during troubleshooting. Capture and perform basic analysis of network traffic using Wireshark or tcpdump. Isolate whether a failure is related to the device, network, cloud service, API, backend or application layer, and involve the appropriate team. Follow existing framework standards and build reusable, readable and maintainable test components. Analyze automation failures, distinguish product defects from script or environment issues and fix tests within assigned scope. Run automated suites through CI/CD pipelines and report failures with supporting evidence. Identify stable, repetitive manual scenarios suitable for automation. Participate in defect triage, daily stand-ups, sprint planning and test-status discussions. Collaborate with software, cloud, firmware, networking and mobile teams to reproduce and resolve issues. Release and Production Support Support release regression, production smoke testing and post-deployment validation as assigned. Hands-on experience in functional, integration, regression and end-to-end testing. Working knowledge of TCP/IP and core networking concepts. Experience testing REST APIs and interpreting JSON request and response data. Programming or test-automation experience using Python. Exposure to UI automation using Playwright, Selenium or an equivalent tool. Ability to analyze logs, reproduce issues and write clear defect reports. Experience using Git and working with CI/CD test execution. Good written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work in a cross-functional team. Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Qualifications Experience testing cloud-managed networking or network management platforms. Hands-on exposure to access points, switches, routers or Wi-Fi test environments. Familiarity with AWS services, microservices, Docker or Kubernetes. Experience with Wireshark, tcpdump and basic packet analysis. Exposure to mobile application testing, performance testing or API security testing. Awareness of Wi-Fi 5, Wi-Fi 6, Wi-Fi 6E or Wi-Fi 7 concepts. title: Software Engineer III- ServiceNow QA Analyst
description: JOB DESCRIPTION We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level. As a Software Engineer III at JPMorgan Chase within the Infrastructure Platforms team, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile delivery team to validate and assure market-leading ServiceNow solutions in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for executing and improving testing practices across ServiceNow applications and workflows, ensuring releases meet functional, integration, performance, and control requirements in support of the firm's business objectives. Perform functional, regression, smoke, integration, and end-to-end testing across ServiceNow and upstream/downstream systems (APIs, MID Server, SSO, CMDB-related integrations). Partner with developers, product owners, and platform teams to review requirements and acceptance criteria, identify test scenarios, and ensure appropriate coverage and traceability. Log, track, and manage defects with clear reproduction steps, severity/priority, and evidence; validate fixes and support release readiness decisions. Produce and maintain test artifacts (test plans, test cases, test data approach, RTM as needed) and contribute to release documentation and operational readiness. Analyze testing results and trends to identify recurring defects, root causes, and quality risks, recommending improvements to process, controls, and platform hygiene. Support CI/CD quality gates by integrating testing into pipelines where applicable and promoting consistent QA standards across environments (DEV/TEST/UAT/PROD). Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness. Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation. Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience Hands-on practical experience in QA/testing within the Software Development Life Cycle, including test design, execution, defect management, and release validation. Experience testing ServiceNow configurations/customizations and understanding of core platform components (tables, forms, lists, ACLs, notifications, workflows/Flow Designer). Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices and QA in iterative release cycles; familiarity with CI/CD concepts and environment promotion practices. Experience with test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow Agile Development, or similar). Basic understanding of web technologies and APIs (HTTP, REST, JSON) and ability to validate integrations using logs and test tools (e.g., Postman or equivalent). Ability to create clear, actionable documentation and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Understanding of security and controls concepts relevant to testing (e.g., access controls/roles, data handling, auditability, evidence capture). Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security. Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices. Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills Experience with ServiceNow test automation (e.g., ATF – Automated Test Framework) and/or automation frameworks/tools used alongside ServiceNow. Familiarity with CMDB and ITIL-aligned processes (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Asset/Discovery). Exposure to performance testing concepts and non-functional testing (availability, resiliency, audit/compliance readiness). Experience validating SSO, LDAP, and multi-system integrations involving MID Server, integration hubs, or enterprise APIs. ABOUT US

Design and execute a balanced set of manual and automated tests, including exploratory, functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end testing; select the test layer and technique that best addresses the risk. Create, maintain, and improve reliable SAHI-based automated test scripts using established design patterns and reusable code; contribute to framework design and evaluate Playwright or Selenium where appropriate. Interpret test and CI/CD results, investigate failures systematically, and distinguish product defects from automation, test-data, or environment issues using logs, browser developer tools, and reproducible evidence. Reduce flaky tests through root-cause analysis; maintain representative test data, repeatable setup and cleanup, dependable environments, and clear, actionable failure reporting. Collaborate with developers and product managers throughout the development lifecycle to improve testability, find defects earlier, and align testing with delivery timelines and product quality goals. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and improve QA processes, tooling, and feedback loops while protecting the stability of existing coverage. Produce concise, accurate test cases, automation code, defect reports, traceability, and quality summaries; communicate coverage, evidence, blockers, and release risks clearly to stakeholders. Share domain knowledge and practical QA and automation techniques with colleagues, and use approved AI tools responsibly where useful while independently validating outputs and protecting proprietary and customer data. Strong hands-on ability in automated and manual testing, including writing, debugging, reviewing, and maintaining reusable automation code with established design patterns; practical programming or scripting skills in JavaScript, Java, or a comparable language; proficiency with Git, code review, and maintainable coding practices; and sound judgment in applying exploratory, functional, regression, and automated testing. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, including interpreting test results and investigating failures with logs, browser developer tools, and reproducible evidence. Experience testing web and client/server products, preferably Java/J2EE enterprise applications, with a good understanding of browser behavior, sessions, authentication, authorization, and integrations. Strong risk-based test-design skills, including equivalence partitioning, boundary-value analysis, and state-transition testing. description: TEST AUTOMATION ENGINEER We are looking for a Test Automation Engineer to be part of our Nestlé Nespresso Digital and Tech Team. At Nespresso, our Digital & Tech teams are at the heart of our innovation journey, a space where we continue to invest, evolve, and grow. Position Snapshot: Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India Type of Contract: Permanent Grade: Band 2 Type of work: Hybrid Work Language: Fluent Business English The Role: As a Test Automation Specialist, you will be working on the Business Applications powering the Nespresso Retail and Trade network, as well as Customer Relations Centers. You will work in an employee-facing applications context, supporting large volumes of internal users and transactions, while being part of a large development organization with a direct impact on the business. As a central part of the software engineering community, you will bring deep technical expertise and knowledge to the product team, being part of the technical reference team for Nespresso web applications and focusing on quality strategy and automation practices. You will guide and promote the optimal use of processes and technology to support the cost-effective delivery of business requirements within your area of expertise. As the Automation Specialist, you will be responsible for ensuring the correct execution of the QA and testing strategy across the Retail, Trade, and Customer Service domains, ensuring the quality and reliability of our business applications, with a strong focus on driving the test automation framework. You will work closely with cross-functional delivery teams to ensure the adoption of QA and testing practices, and with Release and DevOps teams to streamline the release cycle and improve the overall quality of our web applications. You will also make a strong contribution to the QA strategy through a community of practice in collaboration with the QA Office. In This Role, You Will: Apply the test automation framework and infrastructure, ensuring its reliability and scalability. Contribute to the creation of a growing full test automation library. Participate in defining and keeping the QA and testing strategy for our Business Applications up to date. Participate in defining and keeping the test automation strategy and practices for Nespresso up to date, using industry-standard tools and frameworks to ensure maximum test coverage and efficiency. Ensure that cross-functional delivery teams in the Retail, Trade, and Customer Service domains follow the defined guidelines and deliver according to the quality standards of Nespresso release cycles. Mentor and guide QA engineers and testers, providing technical expertise and support in test automation. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, DevOps, and Release Engineers to continuously improve the overall quality and efficiency of the testing process. Actively participate in the QA community of practice alongside QA Leads and the Nespresso QA Office. What We’re Looking For: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 7+ years of professional experience. Proven experience as an Automation Test Engineer or in a similar role, specifically in web application testing. Strong knowledge of API testing methodologies, tools, and frameworks. Proven experience using Gherkin and Xray. Proficiency in using test automation tools and frameworks, such as Playwright. Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines. Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with keen attention to detail. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams. Ability to communicate effectively in English with people at different levels of the organization. Extra Skills That Set You Apart: Passion for technology, test automation, and DevOps, with the ability to bridge technical and non-technical populations in a large organization. Experience working in a global environment and collaborating with virtual teams. We Offer You: We offer more than just a job. Genuine opportunities for career and personal development through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset. title: IT Validation & Automation Engineer
description: Company Description Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years. Job Description Role: Validation Automation Engineer Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India Work mode: Hybrid, Weekly 3 Days WFO Experience: 5–8+ years Reporting line: Manager Role Overview Eurofins BioPharma Product Testing (BPT) operates a global network of bio/pharmaceutical GMP product testing laboratories. BPT is supported by global engineering teams developing and maintaining business-critical laboratory applications, including eLIMS-BPT, Eurofins ELN, eQMS and related platforms. As a Validation Automation Engineer within the BPT delivery and validation function, the successful candidate will ensure continuity, accuracy and compliance of release-validation activities while progressively automating repetitive work. The role combines hands-on IT validation, controlled documentation, requirements traceability and software automation. Quality, compliance and human review remain central as existing processes are converted into reliable and reusable solutions. Required Experience and Skills : 5 to 8 years of relevant experience in software quality engineering, IT validation, test automation or quality/compliance roles supporting regulated applications. Hands-on experience performing validation activities for major and minor releases, patches, emergency changes and production data updates. Experience reviewing release scope, user requirements, Product Backlog Items (PBIs), defects and supporting test evidence for completeness and consistency. Ability to prepare, maintain and reconcile validation checklists, Requests for Change (RfCs), Module Functional Definitions (MFDs), release item lists and requirements traceability records. Good understanding of controlled documentation, document lifecycle, revision history, effectivity dates, review and approval workflows, and audit-ready record keeping. Ability to identify missing evidence, documentation gaps, traceability discrepancies and incorrectly classified functional, non-functional or technical work items. Experience coordinating with functional analysts, test engineers, developers, application owners and quality stakeholders to resolve validation gaps without compromising release timelines. Experience supporting recurring compliance activities such as Production Operational Data Updates (PODUs), SOP updates and controlled document submissions. Ability to understand manual processes, identify automation opportunities and translate them into maintainable scripts, utilities or workflows. Experience developing automation with suitable error handling, logging, traceability, version control and human review checkpoints. Strong analytical, documentation and problem-solving skills, with careful attention to data accuracy and cross-document consistency. Excellent understanding of SDLC, STLC, change control and Agile/Scrum delivery practices. Experience working with geographically distributed stakeholders and managing time-sensitive release deliverables. Specific Technical Skills : Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps for PBIs, bugs, user requirements, work item history, release scope, queries and end-to-end traceability. Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, C#, JavaScript or PowerShell for workflow and data automation. Experience automating validation checklist preparation, evidence collection, work-item history verification, requirements traceability and cross-document reconciliation. Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel for validation checklists, reconciliation, data analysis and controlled reporting. Experience with Microsoft SharePoint and Microsoft Office for controlled documentation, templates, references and supporting records. Working knowledge of quality-management/change-control systems for RfC workflows. Working knowledge of eJIRA or comparable tools for document-control requests and tracking. Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD practices for managing, testing and deploying automation solutions. Ability to validate automated outputs and maintain automation specifications, test results and change history before using outputs in controlled documentation. Good understanding of APIs, JSON, XML, SQL and data extraction techniques is advantageous for integrating validation and reporting workflows. Desirable Experience: Experience in a GxP-regulated, pharmaceutical, laboratory or life-sciences environment. Knowledge of Computer System Validation (CSV), data integrity principles and risk-based validation approaches. Experience supporting LIMS, ELN, eQMS or other regulated laboratory applications. Experience automating Azure DevOps administration or reporting activities, including metrics, dashboards, sprint and work-item management. Exposure to robotic process automation, low-code workflow tools or AI-assisted document and evidence checks within approved quality controls. Understanding of audit preparation, inspection readiness and quality review expectations. Additional Information Personal Skills: Customer-service oriented with a problem-solving attitude; Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential; Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change; Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing); Structured and clear writing skills; Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning; Demonstrated positive attitude, self-motivated, team player. PERFORMANCE APPRAISAL CRITERIA : Eurofins has a strong focus on Performance Management system. This includes quarterly calibrations, half-yearly reviews and annual reviews. The KPIs shall be set and may vary slightly between projects. These will be clearly communicated, documented during the first 30 days of your joining.

description: About Sift Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission-critical systems. You will own correctness test coverage for real-time alerting, from launch through every later release: proving that alerts fire when they should, and only then. Later, you will also cover our integration products: an edge database and viewer that runs on customer machines, our SDKs, command-line tool and data import pipelines. Build tests that prove alerts fire when they should, and only then, across conditions, thresholds, rolling windows and severities. Build independent test data. Generate realistic data and alert scenarios that do not depend on the code under test. Own end-to-end UI testing. Build and maintain browser tests for alert configuration, alert history and status views. Keep them fast, stable and trusted. Validate what users see. Add visual regression checks for status indicators, severity levels, previews and dashboards where they add signal without flakiness. Test the APIs underneath. Write integration tests for backend services against a real database, covering the main paths and the edge cases a design implies but does not spell out. Test authorization thoroughly. Verify who can view, create and change data under role-based, attribute-based and resource-scoped permissions, including the negative cases. Test time-series evaluation. Verify alert logic on real-time data, including late, missing and out-of-order data, backfill, and recovery after a backlog. Compare old and new systems. Validate a new system's results against the one it replaces using generated or anonymized data, and test outbound integrations such as webhooks. Gate alert releases. Define what correctness results block an alerts release, sign off on it, and report risks to the team. Cover our integration products. Map coverage gaps and build regression tests for an offline-first edge database and viewer, our SDKs, command-line tool and data imports, including install and upgrade testing in Sift test environments. Train and guide a QE in another time zone. Onboard a QE who runs regression overnight, and review their results. Shape quality before code merges. Review designs and test plans with engineers, find gaps by reading the code, and raise risks early in plain language. Required Skills: 5+ years in QA automation or SDET roles, covering both UI and backend testing. Strong Playwright and TypeScript skills. You have designed suites, not only written tests. Experience writing integration tests for backend services, ideally in Go, against a real database. Python for test data generation and scripting. Experience testing authorization and access control: roles, attributes and resource-level permissions (RBAC, ABAC). Experience testing time-series or event data, including late, missing and out-of-order data. Strong SQL skills, including setting up test data and reasoning about data access rules. Professional working proficiency in written and spoken English (CEFR B2 or above), used daily for design reviews, test plans, risk reports, working with and training teammates. Testing software that runs on customer hardware or offline. description: 1. Job Objective To independently source, mobilise and deploy production manpower for manufacturing and industrial clients through extensive field-level recruitment activities. The primary responsibility is to fulfil client manpower requirements within committed timelines by generating candidates through local networks, referrals, job consultants and direct field sourcing. The role will be measured based on actual candidate joining, deployment fulfilment and employee retention rather than resumes collected or candidates contacted. 2. Key Roles & Responsibilities A. Field-Level Candidate Sourcing Conduct daily field recruitment activities in industrial locations, nearby villages, towns and residential areas. Identify and source candidates for production operators, helpers, assembly workers, packing staff and other factory-related positions. Develop local candidate networks through referrals, community contacts, job centres and employment agencies. Establish and maintain relationships with local manpower agents and job consultants. Organise local recruitment campaigns and walk-in drives based on client requirements. Build a continuous pipeline of candidates for ongoing and future requirements. B. Candidate Mobilisation & Conversion Explain job opportunities, salary, working conditions, shift timings, overtime, food and transportation facilities to prospective candidates. Screen candidates against client eligibility criteria. Coordinate interviews, trade tests and client selection processes. Convert selected candidates into actual joiners through consistent follow-up. Coordinate document collection, joining formalities and reporting at client locations. Ensure candidates report on the committed joining date without last-minute dropouts. C. Deployment & Retention Management Take ownership of manpower deployment against assigned client requirements. Follow up with every deployed candidate during the initial joining period. Monitor attendance, absenteeism and early attrition. Maintain regular contact with deployed employees to ensure continuity. Coordinate immediate replacements for absenteeism, dropouts and employee exits. Support Operations in maintaining the required manpower strength at client locations. D. Recruitment Reporting & Coordination Submit daily reports covering: Candidates contacted and sourced. Candidates screened and shortlisted. Candidates selected. Confirmed candidates for joining. Actual candidates joined and deployed. Candidates retained and dropouts. Maintain a candidate database with sourcing channel and joining status. Coordinate with Operations and HR for deployment, documentation and attendance verification. Highlight recruitment challenges and provide corrective action plans. 3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Actual Manpower Deployment Number of candidates physically joined and deployed Requirement Fulfilment Percentage of assigned vacancies fulfilled within the agreed timeline Joining Conversion Actual joiners against confirmed candidates 30-Day Retention Percentage of deployed candidates continuing after 30 days 90-Day RetentionPercentage of deployed candidates continuing after 90 days Replacement Fulfilment Timely replacement against dropouts and exits Recruitment Productivity Actual deployment achieved per month Reporting Discipline Timely and accurate daily recruitment reports 4. Suggested Initial Performance Targets These are proposed starting targets and should be calibrated based on the number of active client requirements and sourcing locations. ParameterSuggested Target Actual deployment - 3–5 candidates per working day Monthly deployment - 60–80 candidates Joining conversion - Minimum 70% 30-day retention - Minimum 85% 90-day retention - Minimum 75% Daily reporting100% compliance Retention percentages should be calculated against actual deployed candidates who have completed the respective 30-day or 90-day observation period. 5. Required Skills & Competencies Strong field-level communication and candidate convincing skills. Ability to independently generate candidates without depending entirely on job portals. Good knowledge of industrial and manufacturing locations around Chennai. Strong follow-up and candidate conversion capabilities. Ability to build and manage local manpower sourcing networks. Target-oriented approach with ownership and accountability. Basic knowledge of MS Excel, WhatsApp and recruitment reporting. 6. Additional Requirements Two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred. Willingness to travel extensively for field recruitment. Ability to work independently across multiple industrial locations. Flexibility to conduct recruitment drives based on client deployment requirements. 7. Performance Accountability The Field Recruiter will be directly accountable for converting manpower requirements into actual deployments and ensuring candidate continuity during the initial employment period. Performance evaluation will primarily be based on: Actual manpower joined and deployed. Timely fulfilment of client requirements. Candidate joining conversion. 30-day and 90-day employee retention. Ability to generate candidates through independent field sourcing. Working Conditions Extensive field travel within assigned locations. Flexible working hours based on recruitment drives and business requirements. title: SAP BW / BO / BI Consultant
description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Your role The primary purpose of an SAP BW / BO / BI Consultant is to design, build, and maintain an enterprise’s data warehousing, reporting, and analytics architecture. They transform raw transactional data from SAP (such as S/4HANA, ECC, CRM) and non-SAP source systems into structured, meaningful business intelligence to drive data-backed decision-making. What you will do Data Warehousing & Architecture Design: Lead the end-to-end design, build, and maintenance of scalable enterprise data warehousing, reporting, and analytics architectures. Requirements & Fit-Gap Discovery: Facilitate discovery workshops and requirements gathering with business stakeholders to translate analytical needs into technical specifications and functional designs. ETL & Data Modeling: Architect and build data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) pipelines, converting raw transactional data into structured, optimized data models. Reporting & Dashboard Development: Design and deliver interactive dashboards, operational reports, and self-service business intelligence solutions using SAP BusinessObjects (BO) and modern analytics platforms. Cross-System Data Integration: Develop and manage data integration workflows connecting core SAP source systems (S/4HANA, ECC, CRM) and third-party non-SAP data sources into a unified BI landscape. System Governance & Performance Optimization: Monitor daily data loads, troubleshoot query and extraction bottlenecks, and enforce data accuracy, integrity, and security standards across the reporting environment. Stakeholder Enablement & Support: Partner with business units to drive BI adoption, provide post-implementation support, and empower leadership with reliable, data-backed insights. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career. Your future at Kyndryl Every position offers a transparent trajectory to advance your career—from Senior Consultant to Principal Enterprise Architect and Practice Leader. You will gain access to large-scale enterprise transformation programs, early adoption of S/4HANA Cloud and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) innovations, and hands-on opportunities to lead complex global rollouts. We partner across dynamic sectors including manufacturing, banking, energy, retail, and life sciences. Whether your ambition is to master global statutory requirements, pioneer AI-driven financial analytics, or drive multi-tier ERP migrations, you will have the platform, continuous learning resources, and executive sponsorship to shape your professional journey. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required skills and experience Experience Baseline: 10+ Yrs Proven experience in SAP Business Warehouse (SAP BW / BW/4HANA) and the SAP BusinessObjects (BO) suite, including end-to-end implementation and enterprise support. Data Integration Expertise: Hands-on track record extracting and integrating data from SAP source systems (S/4HANA, ECC, CRM) as well as non-SAP databases and flat files. Data Modeling & ETL: Strong proficiency in enterprise data warehousing principles, multidimensional data modeling, and ETL development. Reporting & Analytics: Demonstrated expertise building complex reports and dashboards across SAP BO tools (such as Web Intelligence, Crystal Reports, and Analysis for Office). Analytical & Communication Skills: Ability to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver actionable, data-backed decision-making tools. Preferred skills and experience Working familiarity with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP Datasphere, or native SAP HANA modeling. Experience with SQL scripting, ABAP routines for BW transformations, and performance tuning of large datasets. Relevant industry certifications in SAP Business Warehouse, SAP BusinessObjects, or SAP Analytics. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related discipline. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.
